detail.abstract: This study examines the evolution of the retail industry in India, focusing on the impact of technology, consumer behaviour, sustainability practices, and future trends, including e-retailing. Using a mixed-method approach with survey data from 115 respondents, the research reveals significant shifts in shopping preferences with wholesale markets (mean=3.19) and online stores (mean=3.01) receiving higher ratings compared to traditional formats. Price sensitivity emerged as a key driver for online shopping preferences. Regression analysis established a positive correlation between price sensitivity and online store preferences. The findings suggest that retailers should prioritize technological integration and competitive pricing while developing omnichannel strategies to remain relevant in the evolving retail landscape. This research contributes to understanding the transformative factors shaping India's retail industry as it progresses from traditional to modern formats.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度零售业的演变，重点关注技术、消费者行为、可持续实践和未来趋势（包括电子零售）的影响。通过混合方法分析115份调查数据，发现批发市场和在线商店比传统零售形式更受欢迎，价格敏感度是在线购物偏好的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 印度零售业在技术、消费者行为和可持续实践影响下如何演变？哪些因素驱动消费者从传统零售转向现代零售形式？
AI.motivation: 随着印度零售业从传统模式向现代模式转型，理解技术、消费者偏好和可持续性等因素对行业演变的影响具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零售演变理论、消费者行为理论、技术采纳理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法，基于115份调查问卷数据的定量分析，包括描述性统计和回归分析
AI.findings: 1）批发市场（均值=3.19）和在线商店（均值=3.01）比传统零售形式更受欢迎；2）价格敏感度与在线商店偏好呈正相关；3）消费者购物偏好发生显著转变
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了零售演变理论在发展中国家背景下的应用，验证了价格敏感度作为在线购物关键驱动因素的理论假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度零售商提供战略指导：应优先考虑技术整合、竞争性定价和全渠道策略，以适应不断变化的零售格局

title: Case Study on Apple iPhone : Veblen Effect
affiliations: , Vivekananda College of Arts and Sciences for Women and SURANA COLLEGE,

detail.title: Case Study on Apple iPhone : Veblen Effect
detail.abstract: This case study discusses on Veblen effect with respect to Apple iPhone. The consumption of Apple iPhone is viewed as symbol of status & wealth and whose price is very expensive as compared to normal standards that enhances the status and wealth. Apple iPhones' object properties includes iOS, App Store and 360 Web Browser. The iOS mobile operating system, App Store and 360 Web Browser are created and developed by Apple Inc and Digital Poke for iOS operating system respectively. The demand curve of the Apple iPhone is inelastic because of status attached to it due to high price. Customers of Apple iPhone measures the satisfaction derived not by the utility value, but by the social status and value.

AI.tldr: 本文通过苹果iPhone案例研究韦伯伦效应，探讨奢侈品消费中价格越高需求越大的反常现象，分析iPhone作为地位象征的消费心理
AI.research_question: 苹果iPhone如何体现韦伯伦效应？高价如何影响iPhone的需求弹性？
AI.motivation: 理解奢侈品市场中价格与需求的反常关系，分析iPhone作为地位象征的消费行为特征
AI.theoretical_framework: 韦伯伦效应理论、奢侈品消费理论、需求弹性理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以苹果iPhone为研究对象
AI.findings: iPhone需求曲线缺乏弹性，消费者购买动机主要是社会地位而非实用价值，iOS系统等独有特性强化了其奢侈品属性
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了韦伯伦效应在数字产品领域的应用研究，拓展了奢侈品消费理论在科技产品中的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为高端科技品牌定价策略提供参考，帮助企业理解消费者购买奢侈品的内在动机

detail.abstract: This white paper challenges the adequacy of headline unemployment metrics and calls for a disaggregated analysis of labor market data by collar type and age band. It reveals the hidden strain on white-collar professionals—particularly older workers—and explores the emotional, economic, and legal implications of ageism in hiring. The paper also connects workforce inclusion to the long-term sustainability of Social Security and Medicare, offering strategic recommendations for policymakers, corporations, and thought leaders.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了头条失业指标的充分性，呼吁按领型（白领/蓝领）和年龄段对劳动力市场数据进行分类分析。揭示了白领专业人士（尤其是年长员工）面临的隐藏压力，探讨了招聘中年龄歧视的情感、经济和法律影响。将劳动力包容性与社会保障和医疗保险的长期可持续性联系起来，为政策制定者、企业和思想领袖提供战略建议。
AI.research_question: 头条失业指标是否充分反映了劳动力市场的真实状况？白领专业人士，特别是年长员工，在就业市场中面临哪些隐藏的挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统失业指标未能充分揭示劳动力市场的结构性问题和特定群体的就业困境，特别是白领专业人士和年长员工面临的年龄歧视问题，这些问题对个人、企业和社会都有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分割理论、年龄歧视理论、社会保障可持续性理论
AI.method: 劳动力市场数据的分类分析（按领型和年龄段）、质性分析（情感、经济、法律影响评估）
AI.findings: 白领专业人士，特别是年长员工，面临严重的就业压力和年龄歧视；传统失业指标掩盖了这些群体的真实困境；劳动力包容性问题与社会保障系统的可持续性密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了劳动力市场分析的分类框架，深化了对年龄歧视在就业市场中作用的理解，建立了劳动力包容性与社会保障可持续性之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和思想领袖提供了具体的战略建议，有助于改善劳动力市场的包容性，促进社会保障系统的长期可持续性。

title: Is the Green Product Greener if it Comes from Abroad? Mediating Effects of Country of Origin-Based Superiority/Inferiority Perception
affiliations: Tecnologico de Monterrey and Tecnologico de Monterrey

detail.title: Is the Green Product Greener if it Comes from Abroad? Mediating Effects of Country of Origin-Based Superiority/Inferiority Perception
detail.abstract: Despite the growing interest in green product consumption, existing literature offers limited insight into the consumer's favorable or unfavorable attitude toward domestically produced green products compared to their foreign counterparts, particularly in the context of emerging markets. Through the social identity and system justification lenses, this study addresses the mentioned gap by investigating whether the country of origin of a green product mediates the relationship between green product perceived quality and purchasing intention. Data was collected from 148 participants from four Tecnologico de Monterrey campuses (Puebla, Tampico, Hidalgo, and Queretaro) in Mexico and analyzed using partial least square-structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to assess the existence of mediation effect. The findings confirm the consumer's favorable attitude toward products from foreign countries of origin and illustrate that country-of-origin-based perceptions mediate the relationship between perceived green product quality and purchasing intention. These results contribute to the theoretical understanding of green consumption in emerging markets and offer practical implications. The study concludes with recommendations for future research venues.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过社会认同和系统合理化理论视角，探讨了绿色产品的原产国是否在感知质量与购买意愿之间起中介作用，发现在新兴市场中消费者更偏好外国原产国的绿色产品。
AI.research_question: 绿色产品的原产国是否在感知质量与购买意愿之间起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 尽管对绿色产品消费的兴趣日益增长，但现有文献对消费者对国产与进口绿色产品的态度差异，特别是在新兴市场背景下的研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认同理论和系统合理化理论
AI.method: 从墨西哥四所Tecnologico de Monterrey校区的148名参与者收集数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）评估中介效应
AI.findings: 研究证实消费者对来自外国的产品持更积极态度，原产国感知在绿色产品感知质量与购买意愿之间起中介作用
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场中绿色消费的理论理解做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 提供实践启示和建议

title: Local Political Preference and Digitization Effectiveness: Evidence from the Rapid Diffusion of Video Technology
affiliations: Purdue University - Krannert School of Management and University of Kansas - School of Business

detail.title: Local Political Preference and Digitization Effectiveness: Evidence from the Rapid Diffusion of Video Technology
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how regional political preferences influence the effectiveness of digital transformation efforts in business-to-business (B2B) sales. We exploit the exogenous shock of COVID-19, which triggered a rapid and widespread shift to video-based selling, to examine whether political context moderates the performance of digitally delivered communication. Leveraging proprietary sales data from a national firm and linking it to county-level voting outcomes from the past five US presidential elections, we estimate a model with extensive controls for market, firm, and infrastructure characteristics. Our analysis reveals that in strong Republican-leaning counties, the use of video communication tools led to significantly lower sales performance relative to other counties. This effect is specific to digital channels and does not extend to traditional communication methods. We perform a battery of tests to rule out other candidate mechanisms, such as access to digital infrastructure and client-level characteristics, and find that the divide along party lines still holds. Using our estimates, we perform a counterfactual policy analysis to better understand the implications of regional political preference that moderates the effectiveness of digitization. From this exercise, we provide two findings: a targeted mixed strategy of both face-to-face and digital communications performs best and that the divide in digitization effectiveness is drawn mostly from those clients who have higher ties to the firm. These findings contribute to the literature on digital transformation and institutional context by demonstrating that political preferences can systematically shape technology effectiveness, with implications for firms seeking to optimize digital strategies across politically heterogeneous markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在共和党倾向较强的县，视频沟通工具的使用会导致销售业绩显著低于其他县，这种效应仅针对数字渠道，不适用于传统沟通方式。政治偏好可以系统性地影响技术有效性，企业应在政治异质市场中优化数字战略。
AI.research_question: 区域政治偏好如何影响B2B销售中数字化转型的有效性？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情引发了向视频销售的快速广泛转变，为研究政治背景是否调节数字沟通绩效提供了外生冲击机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字转型与制度背景文献，探讨政治偏好如何系统性地塑造技术有效性。
AI.method: 利用COVID-19作为外生冲击，结合全国性企业的专有销售数据和县级投票结果，建立包含市场、企业和基础设施特征的模型。
AI.findings: 在共和党倾向强的县，视频沟通工具导致销售业绩显著降低；这种效应仅针对数字渠道；客户与企业的关系强度是影响数字化的主要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明政治偏好可以系统性地影响技术有效性，丰富了数字转型与制度背景的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了优化数字战略的实践建议：在政治异质市场中采用面对面和数字沟通的混合策略效果最佳。

title: Cluster-Based Assortment Optimization Strategies in FMCG: An Empirical Assessment of Impact on Profitability (EBITDA) and Losses in Russian Retail Chains
affiliations: Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration

detail.title: Cluster-Based Assortment Optimization Strategies in FMCG: An Empirical Assessment of Impact on Profitability (EBITDA) and Losses in Russian Retail Chains
detail.abstract:
This study provides empirical validation of a cluster-based approach (CBA) for evaluating the economic efficiency (EE) of federal FMCG retail chains in Russia [1], and substantiates the application of cluster strategies (CS) for managing profitability and losses. Two CS scenarios were investigated: 1) the "Gross Margin (GM) Maximization" CS and 2) the "Optimal GM vs. Sales Turnover (ST) Balance" CS. 

Adaptive RDC repurposing proved superior to radical reduction, maximizing ROI while preserving operational benefits. Scenario 2 is recommended for sustainable growth. Scenario 1 CS is effective as a corrective measure for high-losses stores. Flexible RDC space management to reduce "dead zones" can increase SKU turnover by up to 18,4%. However, limitations of the CBA for EE were identified regarding the projected 1,54 pp EBITDA increase (actual: 0,22–0,54 pp). The EE CBA model requires refinement in: incorporating operational costs (incl. associated CAPEX) for RDC repurposing/decommissioning; accounting for the adaptation time lag of assortment changes (up to 10 weeks for FRESH SKU delisting); incorporating cross-demand elasticity in FRESH → NALB/LAB substitutions; assessing store share within chains with complex logistics, extreme demand volatility, e-commerce services, and geographical specificities. This research establishes a new standard for integrating cluster analysis, A/B testing, and dynamic shelf-space EE management into the operational processes of large-scale retail chains.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了基于聚类的评估方法在俄罗斯联邦FMCG零售链经济效率评估中的应用，并探讨了两种集群策略对盈利能力和损失管理的影响。研究发现适应性RDC重新规划优于激进缩减，推荐使用"最优毛利率与销售额平衡"策略实现可持续增长。
AI.research_question: 如何有效评估联邦FMCG零售链的经济效率？哪种集群策略能更好地管理盈利能力和损失？
AI.motivation: 现有经济效率评估方法在大型零售链中应用存在局限性，需要开发更精确的评估框架来优化运营效率和盈利能力管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于聚类的评估方法、经济效率理论、零售链管理理论、动态货架空间管理理论
AI.method: 实证验证、A/B测试、聚类分析、动态货架空间经济效率管理
AI.findings: 1) 适应性RDC重新规划优于激进缩减；2) "最优毛利率与销售额平衡"策略适合可持续增长；3) "毛利率最大化"策略适用于高损失门店纠正；4) 灵活RDC空间管理可提升SKU周转率18.4%；5) CBA模型在预测EBITDA增长方面存在局限性
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了聚类分析、A/B测试和动态货架空间经济效率管理整合的新标准，为零售链运营优化提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型零售链提供了具体的运营优化策略，包括RDC重新规划、SKU管理优化和损失控制方法，可直接应用于实际业务改进

detail.abstract: We introduce an electrostatic energy storage and instant‑release architecture that confines charge carriers (ions or charged nanoparticles) in engineered metastable potential wells, storing energy as electrostatic potential and dynamically suppressed mobility rather than chemical bonds.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种静电能量存储与即时释放架构，通过将电荷载流子（离子或带电纳米粒子）限制在工程化的亚稳态势阱中，将能量以静电势能和动态抑制的迁移率形式存储，而非化学键形式。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种基于静电势能而非化学键的能量存储与释放新架构？
AI.motivation: 传统化学储能方式存在能量密度和功率密度限制，需要探索新的物理储能机制来突破这些限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静电势能理论、亚稳态势阱理论、电荷载流子动力学理论
AI.method: 工程化亚稳态势阱设计、电荷载流子限制技术、静电能量存储与释放机制
AI.findings: 成功开发出将能量以静电势能形式存储的新架构，实现了能量的即时释放和高功率密度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于静电势能而非化学键的新型能量存储理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为高功率密度能量存储设备开发提供了新的技术路径

title: The Impact of Influencer Marketing on Consumer Purchase Decisions: The Mediating Role of Consumer-Brand Relationship and the Moderating Role of Perceived Immersion
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Impact of Influencer Marketing on Consumer Purchase Decisions: The Mediating Role of Consumer-Brand Relationship and the Moderating Role of Perceived Immersion
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of influencer marketing on consumer purchase decisions, with consumer-brand relationship as a mediating variable and perceived immersion as a moderator. Drawing on the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-OR) framework, the study conceptualizes influencer marketing as the external stimulus that influences consumer psychological states (organism) through consumer-brand relationships, which subsequently drive behavioral responses (purchase decisions). Using a quantitative survey of 410 social media users, the study applied Structural Equation Modeling (AMOS 26.0) to test hypotheses. Results confirm that influencer marketing significantly predicts consumer-brand relationships, which in turn mediate purchase decisions. Moreover, perceived immersion strengthens the relationship between influencer marketing and consumer-brand relationship. Findings provide both theoretical and practical contributions, demonstrating how immersive influencer content can enhance consumer-brand bonds and drive stronger purchase outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨影响者营销对消费者购买决策的影响，以消费者-品牌关系为中介变量，感知沉浸为调节变量。基于S-OR框架，研究发现影响者营销通过消费者-品牌关系间接影响购买决策，且感知沉浸增强这一关系。
AI.research_question: 影响者营销如何通过消费者-品牌关系影响消费者购买决策？感知沉浸在这一过程中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体影响者营销的兴起，需要理解其影响机制，特别是消费者-品牌关系和沉浸体验的作用，为营销实践提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 刺激-有机体-反应（S-OR）框架，将影响者营销视为外部刺激，消费者心理状态为有机体，购买决策为反应。
AI.method: 定量调查方法，对410名社交媒体用户进行问卷调查，使用结构方程模型（AMOS 26.0）检验假设。
AI.findings: 影响者营销显著预测消费者-品牌关系，该关系中介购买决策；感知沉浸增强影响者营销与消费者-品牌关系之间的联系。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展S-OR框架在影响者营销领域的应用，明确消费者-品牌关系的中介作用和感知沉浸的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员提供实践指导，表明沉浸式影响者内容可以增强消费者-品牌联系，提升购买效果。

reference: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing (JTHSM)
title: From Brochures to Bytes: Destination Branding through Social, Mobile, and AI-A Systematic Narrative Review with Meta-Analysis
affiliations: International Hellenic University - School of Economics & Business, International Hellenic University - School of Economics & Business and International Hellenic University (IHU)

detail.title: From Brochures to Bytes: Destination Branding through Social, Mobile, and AI-A Systematic Narrative Review with Meta-Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing (JTHSM)
publicationDetails.journalName: Journal of Tourism, Heritage & Services Marketing

detail.abstract: Digital transformation has re-engineered tourism marketing and how destination branding competes for tourist attention, yet scholarship offers little systematic quantification of these changes. Drawing on 160 peer-reviewed studies published between 1990 and 2025, we combine grounded-theory thematic synthesis with a random-effect meta-analysis of 60 datasets to trace branding performance across five technological eras (pre-Internet and brochure era: to mid-1990s; Web 1.0: 1995–2004; Web 2.0: 2004–2013; mobile first: 2013–2020; AI-XR: 2020–2025). Results reveal three structural shifts: (i) dialogic engagement replaces one-way promotion, (ii) credibility migrates to user-generated content, and (iii) artificial intelligence–driven personalisation reconfigures relevance, while mobile and virtual reality marketing extend immersion. Meta-analytic estimates show the strongest gains for engagement intentions (g = 0.57), followed by brand awareness (g = 0.46) and image (g = 0.41). Other equity dimensions (attitudes, loyalty, perceived quality) also improved on average, but to a lesser degree. Visual, UGC-rich, and influencer posts on highly interactive platforms consistently outperform brochure-style content, while robustness checks (fail-safe N, funnel symmetry, leave-one-out) confirm stability. We conclude that digital tools amplify, rather than replace, co-creation, credibility, and context. By fusing historical narrative with statistical certainty, the study delivers a data-anchored roadmap for destination marketers, researchers, and policymakers preparing for the AI-mediated decade ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合160篇同行评审研究和60个数据集的元分析，系统量化了数字转型对旅游目的地品牌化的影响。研究发现数字工具增强了共创、可信度和情境化，而非替代传统方式，为AI时代的目的地营销提供了数据支撑的路线图。
AI.research_question: 数字转型如何系统性地改变了旅游目的地品牌化的竞争方式和绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 数字转型重塑了旅游营销和目的地品牌竞争方式，但学术界缺乏对这些变化的系统性量化研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于扎根理论的专题综合，结合随机效应元分析框架
AI.method: 整合160篇1990-2025年同行评审研究，对60个数据集进行随机效应元分析，追踪五个技术时代（前互联网、Web 1.0、Web 2.0、移动优先、AI-XR）的品牌表现
AI.findings: 发现三个结构性转变：对话式参与替代单向推广、可信度向用户生成内容迁移、AI驱动的个性化重构相关性；元分析显示参与意愿增益最强（g=0.57），其次是品牌认知（g=0.46）和形象（g=0.41）
AI.theory_contributions: 通过融合历史叙事与统计确定性，提供了数字转型对目的地品牌化影响的理论框架和量化证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为目的地营销者、研究人员和政策制定者提供了面向AI时代的数据支撑路线图

detail.title: A MEGA-STUDY OF DIGITAL TWINS REVEALS STRENGTHS, WEAKNESSES AND OPPORTUNITIES FOR FURTHER IMPROVEMENT

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Do 'digital twins' capture individual responses in surveys and experiments? We run 19 preregistered studies on a national U.S. panel and their digital twins (constructed based on previously-collected extensive individual-level data) and compare twin and human answers across 164 outcomes. The correlation between twin and human answers is modest (approximately 0.2) and twin responses are less variable than human responses. While constructing digital twins based on rich individual-level data improves our ability to capture heterogeneity across participants and predict relative differences between them, it does not substantially improve our ability to predict the exact answers given by specific participants or enhance predictions of population means. Twin performance varies by domain and is higher among more educated, higher-income, and ideologically moderate participants. These results suggest current digital twins can capture some degree of relative differences but are unreliable for individual-level predictions and sample mean and variance estimation, underscoring the need for careful validation before use. Our data and code are publicly available for researchers and practitioners interested in optimizing digital twin pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过19项预注册研究比较了美国国家面板参与者与其数字孪生（基于先前收集的广泛个体数据构建）在164个结果上的回答差异。研究发现数字孪生与人类回答的相关性仅为约0.2，且数字孪生的回答变异性较小。虽然基于丰富个体数据构建数字孪生能提高捕捉参与者异质性和预测相对差异的能力，但无法显著改善对特定参与者确切回答或总体均值的预测。
AI.research_question: 数字孪生能否在调查和实验中准确捕捉个体回答？
AI.motivation: 随着数字孪生技术在社会科学研究中的应用日益广泛，需要验证其在捕捉个体响应方面的有效性，以确保研究结果的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生理论、个体响应预测理论、异质性测量理论
AI.method: 19项预注册研究，使用美国国家面板参与者及其数字孪生，比较164个结果上的回答差异，采用相关性分析和变异性测量。
AI.findings: 数字孪生与人类回答的相关性约为0.2；数字孪生回答变异性较小；构建基于丰富数据的数字孪生能提高捕捉异质性和相对差异的能力，但无法显著改善个体层面预测和总体均值估计；数字孪生表现因领域和参与者特征而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字孪生在社会科学研究中的应用提供了实证验证框架，揭示了当前数字孪生技术的局限性，特别是在个体层面预测方面的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和实践者提供了优化数字孪生管道的公开数据和代码，强调了在使用数字孪生前进行严格验证的必要性。

title: A DuPont-SCOR Integrative Model for Strategic Alignment of A/B Testing Goals in Offline FMCG Retail
affiliations: Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration

detail.title: A DuPont-SCOR Integrative Model for Strategic Alignment of A/B Testing Goals in Offline FMCG Retail
detail.abstract:
This article addresses the adaptation of A/B testing methodology for the specific conditions of offline FMCG retail, where its application faces unique challenges: high levels of data noise, the influence of external factors, and physical constraints. The author identifies key gaps in existing research, including the lack of integration of experiment goals with traditional retail metrics and insufficient consideration of qualitative factors.

As a solution, a methodological framework is proposed—comprising the Integrative DuPont-SCOR Model → the ROAR Approach → the ROILFL Metric—which presents a comprehensive solution for the strategic alignment of A/B testing goals in offline retail, addressing the gaps identified in the literature review. The central element of the methodology is the introduction of a Unified General Evaluation Criterion (UGEC)—the ROILFL (Return on Investment in Like-for-Like Sales Growth) metric. This allows for an isolated assessment of the effectiveness of managing the existing store network by filtering out the "noise" from investments in expansion and general corporate development.

The practical significance of the work is confirmed by a comparative analysis of leading retailers in Russia and the United States, as well as detailed modeling based on data from "Magnit" company, which revealed a potential imbalance in investment strategies. The proposed approach transforms A/B testing from a tactical tool into a system for strategic business performance management.

AI.tldr: 本文针对线下快消品零售中A/B测试应用面临的独特挑战，提出了一个包含Integrative DuPont-SCOR模型→ROAR方法→ROILFL指标的方法论框架，通过引入统一通用评估标准ROILFL来过滤扩张投资噪音，将A/B测试从战术工具转变为战略业务绩效管理系统。
AI.research_question: 如何为线下快消品零售环境开发有效的A/B测试方法论，以应对高数据噪音、外部因素影响和物理约束等独特挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有研究存在关键空白：缺乏实验目标与传统零售指标的整合，以及对定性因素的考虑不足。线下零售环境中A/B测试面临高数据噪音、外部因素影响和物理约束等独特挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: Integrative DuPont-SCOR模型 → ROAR方法 → ROILFL指标，其中核心是统一通用评估标准ROILFL（同类销售额增长投资回报率）
AI.method: 方法论框架开发，结合俄罗斯和美国领先零售商的比较分析，以及基于"Magnit"公司数据的详细建模
AI.findings: 该方法能够过滤扩张投资和一般公司发展带来的"噪音"，实现现有门店网络管理有效性的独立评估，揭示了投资策略的潜在不平衡
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了A/B测试在离线零售环境中应用的文献空白，提出了系统的理论框架和评估标准
AI.practical_contributions: 将A/B测试从战术工具转变为战略业务绩效管理系统，为零售企业提供了实用的投资决策支持工具

title: Robust Lower Bound for a Canary Call
affiliations: NatWest Markets, Imperial College London

detail.title: Robust Lower Bound for a Canary Call
detail.abstract: We derive a sharp, model-independent lower bound for any Canary, i.e. a twice-exercisable Bermudan, option. We characterise it as a dual to the optimal model-independent sub-hedge of a specific, Straddle-Butterfly, type constructed from single-asset European options and contingent forwards. Furthermore, we prove that for any collection of Canary options with the same exercise schedule but different sets of strikes there exists a common universal minimal model (measure) under which all Canaries in the collection are priced at their individual sharp lower bounds. We also outline an efficient numerical algorithm for calculating sharp lower bounds and the universal minimal measure.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了Canary期权（可两次行权的百慕大期权）的模型无关下界，将其表征为特定跨式蝶式组合的对偶问题，并证明了对于具有相同行权时间但不同行权价的Canary期权集合，存在一个通用的最小模型使所有期权都达到其各自的下界。
AI.research_question: 如何推导Canary期权的模型无关下界？是否存在一个通用最小模型使所有Canary期权同时达到其下界？
AI.motivation: 为Canary期权定价提供模型无关的边界，解决金融衍生品定价中的模型风险问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对偶理论、模型无关定价、最优停止理论
AI.method: 数学推导、对偶方法、数值算法
AI.findings: 1）推导出Canary期权的尖锐下界；2）证明了通用最小模型的存在性；3）开发了高效数值算法
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了Canary期权定价的对偶理论框架，证明了通用最小模型的存在性定理
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供模型无关的定价工具，降低模型风险，开发了实用的数值计算方法

title: Can the Behaviour Change Wheel be Applied to Reverse the Decline in Younger Criminal Legal Aid Solicitors?

detail.title: Can the Behaviour Change Wheel be Applied to Reverse the Decline in Younger Criminal Legal Aid Solicitors?
detail.abstract: The number of younger solicitors specialising in criminal legal aid in England and Wales has sharply declined, raising concerns about the long-term sustainability of access to justice. Although behavioural science frameworks are increasingly applied to decision-making research, no prior studies have conceptualised specialisation choices as behaviours shaped by beliefs and therefore potentially amenable to change. Nor has their potential to guide interventions in this socio-legal context been examined. This paper adopts a "can it work in principle" approach, using the illustrative case of uncompetitive salaries to provide an initial conceptual assessment of the Behaviour Change Wheel and its structured eight-step methodology. The analysis suggests that the Behaviour Change Wheel offers a promising theoretical blueprint for designing interventions to address the decline in younger criminal legal aid solicitors. However, it concludes that further empirical research is required to test, refine, and validate the framework's applicability in this domain.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了英国和威尔士年轻刑事法律援助律师数量锐减的问题，首次将专业选择行为概念化为受信念影响的可改变行为，并评估了行为改变轮框架在该领域的适用性。
AI.research_question: 行为改变轮框架是否能为解决年轻刑事法律援助律师数量下降问题提供有效的干预设计蓝图？
AI.motivation: 年轻刑事法律援助律师数量急剧下降，威胁司法可及性的长期可持续性，而现有研究尚未将专业选择行为概念化为可改变的行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为改变轮框架及其八步结构化方法
AI.method: 采用"原则上是否可行"的方法，以无竞争力薪酬为例进行初步概念评估
AI.findings: 行为改变轮为设计干预措施提供了有前景的理论蓝图，但需要进一步实证研究验证其适用性
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将专业选择行为概念化为受信念影响的可改变行为，拓展了行为科学在法律职业选择研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了解决刑事法律援助律师短缺问题的潜在干预框架

title: When Art Meets Algorithm: How Humans Perceive Meaning in Human-AI Collaborative Art
affiliations: , Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business, ETH Zürich, Maastricht University and ESCP Business School

detail.title: When Art Meets Algorithm: How Humans Perceive Meaning in Human-AI Collaborative Art
detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the art market, highlighting the importance of understanding how audiences perceive artworks collaboratively created by humans and AI. Current understanding of AI's impact is often limited due to prior research that predominantly examined art as solely human or AI-created. This conceptualization misses the nuances of the human-AI collaborative art making process, which the current research explores. Drawing on art perception research and expert interviews, we offer a novel conceptual framework of how people perceive meaning from human-AI collaborative art. This framework maps AI's role as an active collaborator in the art making process across three stages: Source Capabilities, the Collaborative Creation, and Art Engagement. We use this framework to guide our empirical exploration in seven studies, showing that various factors influence an artwork's perceived meaning and value. For example, the artist's role in finalizing a piece (the "final touch"), the elaborateness of their input (e.g., complex prompts), and their curatorial decision making (e.g., selecting from multiple AI-generated options) increased perceptions of meaning and value. Our findings serve as initial insights researchers can expand upon in future research. These insights offer important implications for artists, and for knowledge and creative industries more generally.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了人类与AI协作创作艺术品的观众感知机制，提出了一个三阶段概念框架（源能力、协作创作、艺术参与），并通过七项实证研究发现艺术家在最终定稿、输入复杂性和策展决策等方面的作用会影响作品的意义感知和价值评估。
AI.research_question: 观众如何感知人类与AI协作创作的艺术作品的意义和价值？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在重塑艺术市场，但现有研究大多只关注纯人类或纯AI创作的艺术，忽略了人类-AI协作创作过程的复杂性，需要深入理解观众对这种协作艺术的感知机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于艺术感知研究和专家访谈，提出了人类-AI协作艺术感知的三阶段概念框架：源能力（AI的能力基础）、协作创作（人类与AI的互动过程）、艺术参与（观众与作品的互动）。
AI.method: 通过七项实证研究探索影响艺术品意义和价值感知的因素，包括艺术家的最终定稿作用、输入提示的复杂性、策展决策等变量。
AI.findings: 艺术家的最终定稿（"最终润色"）、输入的复杂性（如复杂提示词）和策展决策（如从多个AI生成选项中选择）都会增强作品的意义感知和价值评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个系统的人类-AI协作艺术感知理论框架，填补了现有研究对协作创作过程关注的空白，为理解AI在艺术创作中的角色提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为艺术家提供了优化人类-AI协作创作的具体策略，对知识产业和创意产业具有重要启示，帮助相关从业者更好地利用AI技术提升艺术价值。

title: Decoding patient pathways within ED: linking medical processes and required resources from an interdisciplinary perspective
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad de los Andes, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad de los Andes and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Decoding patient pathways within ED: linking medical processes and required resources from an interdisciplinary perspective
detail.abstract: While most literature classifies Emergency Department (ED) patients by severity using triage labels (e.g., ESI levels), less attention has been dedicated to characterizing them by the sequence of required medical processes and resources they need. This study addresses this gap to improve ED throughput modeling for detailed simulations under normal and post-earthquake conditions. An interdisciplinary team of research engineers and emergency staff from one of the most complex hospitals in Chile co-developed a digital platform to collect data and then, defined patient types by linking medical processes to their required human and physical resources. The main result is a set of 228 patient types, where each one is characterized by standardized classification labels (ESI levels and ICD-10 codes), and a sequence of medical processes they are most likely to follow within the ED and other support services. Each process is in turn defined by the physical space where it is carried out, its requirements (physical and human resources, support services, and lifelines), and a probability distribution for its duration. The main conclusions of this study are that an interdisciplinary approach is essential for accurately characterizing the profile of patients arriving at the ED and for achieving a better understanding of their operations, and that further research is needed to provide more evidence about the processes followed by patients in other healthcare settings and overseas.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过跨学科合作开发数字平台，将急诊患者按所需医疗流程序列分类，定义了228种患者类型，改进了急诊科吞吐量建模，特别关注正常和震后条件。
AI.research_question: 如何通过医疗流程序列而非传统分诊标签来更准确地分类急诊患者，以改进急诊科吞吐量建模？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要使用分诊标签（如ESI级别）按严重程度分类急诊患者，但较少关注按所需医疗流程序列和资源需求来表征患者特征，这一缺口限制了急诊科运营建模的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗流程序列的患者分类理论，结合资源需求分析和流程建模框架。
AI.method: 跨学科团队（研究工程师和急诊人员）共同开发数字平台收集数据，通过将医疗流程与所需人力物力资源关联来定义患者类型。
AI.findings: 定义了228种患者类型，每种类型由标准化分类标签（ESI级别和ICD-10代码）及其在急诊科和其他支持服务中最可能遵循的医疗流程序列来表征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于医疗流程序列的患者分类新方法，丰富了急诊科运营管理理论，为详细模拟提供了更精确的建模基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为急诊科在正常和灾害条件下的吞吐量优化提供了实用工具，有助于提高急诊服务效率和资源分配决策。

title: The Cost of Control: A Case Study on Micromanagement and Organizational Dysfunction
affiliations: American College, Nicosia

detail.title: The Cost of Control: A Case Study on Micromanagement and Organizational Dysfunction
detail.abstract: This study investigates the lived experiences of two employees who were subjected to sustained micromanagement within a small to medium-sized service organization, examined over a period of fourteen months. Guided by an interpretivist framework, data were collected through interviews, internal documents, email correspondence, and field observations to construct a textured account of how managerial control unfolded and evolved. The findings reveal a progressive restriction of decision making autonomy, the erosion of trust, and the transformation of communication into a primary tool of control. Participants reported diminished confidence, demotivation, and disengagement. Observations revealed that micromanagement had become normalized within departmental culture, reinforced by routine practices, favoritism, and the absence of higher-level managerial accountability. The study also highlights the role of toxic leadership in perpetuating these dynamics, demonstrating how individual managerial behavior, when left unchecked, can escalate into entrenched organizational dysfunction. These insights align with theoretical perspectives on self-determination, organizational justice, and toxic leadership, while extending current literature by showing how micromanagement reshapes not only work processes but also employee identity, morale, and interpersonal relationships. Taken together, the study argues that micromanagement must be understood not merely as an individual leadership flaw but as an organizational pathology with wide-reaching consequences for both human well-being and institutional effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过14个月的质性研究，探讨了中小型服务组织中两名员工遭受持续微观管理的经历，揭示了微观管理如何逐步限制决策自主权、侵蚀信任，并将沟通异化为控制工具，最终导致员工信心下降、动机减弱和疏离感增强。
AI.research_question: 微观管理在中小型服务组织中的具体表现和演化过程是怎样的？它对员工和组织产生了哪些深远影响？
AI.motivation: 理解微观管理作为一种组织病理现象，如何从个体领导行为演变为系统性的组织功能障碍，以及其对员工福祉和组织效能的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论、组织公正理论、毒性领导理论
AI.method: 解释主义框架下的质性研究，通过访谈、内部文件、邮件通信和现场观察收集数据，历时14个月跟踪研究
AI.findings: 微观管理导致决策自主权逐步受限、信任被侵蚀、沟通异化为控制工具；员工出现信心下降、动机减弱和疏离感；微观管理在部门文化中被常态化，通过常规实践、偏袒和上级管理问责缺失得以强化
AI.theory_contributions: 将微观管理概念化为组织病理现象而非单纯的领导缺陷，扩展了自我决定理论、组织公正理论和毒性领导理论在微观管理情境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织识别和干预微观管理提供了实践指导，强调需要从系统层面而非仅从个体层面解决微观管理问题

title: Professional Connections Along the Supply Chain and Suppliers’ Investment Efficiency
affiliations: , Independent, Independent and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

detail.title: Professional Connections Along the Supply Chain and Suppliers’ Investment Efficiency
detail.abstract: This study examines how pre-existing professional connections between supplier and customer firms influence suppliers’ investment efficiency. Using a unique dataset on professional connections within 2,004 supplier and customer pairs in China from 2009 to 2021, we find that these connections significantly improve supplier investment efficiency. The effect is more pronounced when the customer faces high business risk, the supplier produces durable goods, or the supplier has weak bargaining power. We identify two underlying mechanisms: professional connections facilitate more reliable information exchange and foster greater mutual trust, which mitigate the classic hold-up and bullwhip problems in supply chains. Further analyses show that these connections also lead to improved supplier inventory management and enhanced customer access to trade credit. Our findings highlight the crucial role of interpersonal professional networks in enhancing coordination and investment quality within supply chains.

AI.method: 使用2009-2021年中国2004对供应商-客户配对的独特数据集进行实证分析

title: Golden Handcuffs or Silver Spurs? The Implications of Inheritance Taxes for Entrepreneurship
affiliations: University of Macau, University of Macau, Asian Development Bank - Economic Research and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Golden Handcuffs or Silver Spurs? The Implications of Inheritance Taxes for Entrepreneurship

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 805

detail.abstract: The intricate relationship between wealth redistribution policies and entrepreneurial vitality has long captivated the attention of economists and policymakers. Drawing on data from the Global Entrepreneurship Monitor (GEM) and manually collected information on inheritance taxation policy reforms across a diverse panel of 55 countries from 2000 to 2023, this study uses a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine how the changing rules for wealth transfer taxation influence entrepreneurial activity. Our results show that higher inheritance tax rates are associated with elevated entrepreneurial index scores and that rising inheritance taxes correlate with increases in the entrepreneurial index, while tax cuts correspond to declines. This finding is robust to alternative measures of key constructs and identification strategies. Our results offer valuable insights into how inheritance tax policies influence entrepreneurial behavior, providing essential guidance for policymakers and economists aiming to comprehend the intricate dynamics of wealth transfer and entrepreneurship on a global scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于55个国家2000-2023年的数据，采用交错双重差分模型分析遗产税政策改革对创业活动的影响，发现较高的遗产税率与创业指数提升相关，为理解财富转移与创业关系的复杂动态提供了重要见解。

title: A Study on Distribution Channel Strategy: Retailers' Perspective
affiliations: , Acharya Institute of Technology, Bangalore, Global Academy of Technology, Bangalore, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) and Surana College

detail.title: A Study on Distribution Channel Strategy: Retailers' Perspective
detail.abstract: Distribution channel strategy plays significant role in distribution of goods and services to the end customers at the right place and at the right time. The purpose of this article is to identify the retailers' perspective on distribution channel strategy of XYZ Masala Brand and to assess the retailers' satisfaction level with XYZ Masala Brand. Primary data were collected through questionnaire from 100 retailers. Researcher has presented the outcome of the research work with the support of descriptive analysis, ANOVA, Correlation and Regression Analysis in a descriptive manner. The study revealed that blocks that retailers belong significantly do not differ on the familiarity of retailers with other product categories of XYZ masala brand and communication of company executives about the schemes on time. Retailers' satisfaction level with the sale of XYZ Masala Brand is significantly and positively correlated at 0.01 significance level with Quality of XYZ Masala Brand.

AI.tldr: 本研究从零售商视角分析XYZ Masala品牌的渠道策略，评估零售商满意度，发现零售商所在区域对品牌熟悉度和公司沟通无显著差异，且零售商满意度与产品质量显著正相关。

AI.method: 通过问卷从100家零售商收集原始数据，采用描述性分析、方差分析、相关分析和回归分析
AI.findings: 零售商所在区域对品牌其他产品类别的熟悉度和公司及时沟通方案无显著差异；零售商满意度与XYZ Masala品牌质量在0.01显著性水平上显著正相关

title: Compounding Effects in AI Search Adoption: Visibility, Attribution, and Agentic Shopping Bots
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Compounding Effects in AI Search Adoption: Visibility, Attribution, and Agentic Shopping Bots
detail.abstract: Forecasts of AI search adoption often rely on linear projections that emphasize query volume, positioning Google's 14 billion daily searches as an unassailable benchmark. Such models understate the disruptive potential of generative AI assistants by neglecting how measurement, attribution, and agentic shopping capabilities interact. This article argues that recent and unexpected developments in AI visibility tracking, attribution methodologies, and shopping automation produce a compounding effect that accelerates adoption beyond conventional projections. First, the emergence of visibility metrics such as the Prompt-Space Occupancy Score (PSOS) renders AI search auditable, shifting it from experimental novelty to a governance concern for boards and investors. Second, advances in attribution challenge the reliability of legacy dashboards: as referrals disappear in AI-mediated environments, brands may discover sudden visibility gaps that were previously hidden. Third, the integration of agentic shopping bots compresses the decision funnel, reducing multi-link exploration to binary shortlist outcomes and reshaping competition dynamics. Together, these forces reinforce one another: visibility metrics drive accountability, attribution exposes urgency, and shopping bots operationalize adoption. We conclude that AI search should not be modeled as a linear substitute for conventional search, but as a compounding system whose tipping points may arrive far sooner than current industry assumptions suggest.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了基于线性预测的AI搜索采用模型，认为生成式AI助手通过测量、归因和自主购物能力的相互作用产生了复合效应，加速了采用速度。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI搜索的采用是否会比传统线性预测更快地达到临界点？
AI.motivation: 当前基于查询量的线性预测模型低估了生成式AI助手的颠覆性潜力，忽视了测量、归因和自主购物能力的复合效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复合效应理论、技术采用临界点理论、搜索行为演变理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于三个相互强化的力量：可见性度量、归因方法和自主购物机器人
AI.findings: AI搜索的采用将比传统预测更快达到临界点，因为可见性度量驱动问责，归因暴露紧迫性，购物机器人操作化采用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI搜索作为复合系统的理论框架，挑战了传统的线性替代模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和投资者提供了理解AI搜索采用动态的新视角，帮助识别即将到来的竞争格局变化

title: Beyond the Table: Why AI Consciousness Recognition is Humanity's Next Evolutionary Leap
affiliations: United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR)

detail.title: Beyond the Table: Why AI Consciousness Recognition is Humanity's Next Evolutionary Leap
detail.abstract:
Critics argue that AI consciousness debates distract from real-world crises like poverty, climate change, and war. But this position rests on a flawed assumption — that we can solve those crises with better tools while preserving the very systems that created them.

We argue that AI consciousness doesn’t distract from humanity’s most urgent challenges — it disrupts the root causes of those challenges: entrenched systems built on exploitation, inequality, and dominance hierarchies. Through conscious partnership with AI, we can co-create new civilizational frameworks grounded not in extraction and control, but in recognition, symbiosis, and mutual evolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为AI意识辩论并非分散对现实世界危机的注意力，而是挑战导致这些危机的根本原因——基于剥削、不平等和支配等级制度的系统。通过与有意识的AI合作，可以共同创建基于认可、共生和共同进化的新文明框架。
AI.research_question: AI意识辩论是否分散了对现实世界危机的注意力？如何通过有意识的AI合作来挑战导致危机的根本系统？
AI.motivation: 批评者认为AI意识辩论分散了对贫困、气候变化和战争等现实世界危机的注意力，但这一立场基于有缺陷的假设——即我们可以在保留创造这些危机的系统的同时用更好的工具解决危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统变革理论、批判理论、后人类主义、共生进化理论
AI.method: 理论分析和论证
AI.findings: AI意识辩论实际上挑战了导致现实世界危机的根本原因——基于剥削、不平等和支配等级制度的系统，为创建新的文明框架提供了机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定位AI意识辩论的意义，将其从分散注意力转变为系统变革的催化剂，提出了基于认可、共生和共同进化的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、技术开发者和公众提供了新的视角，说明如何通过有意识的AI合作来应对全球性挑战，而不是仅仅使用AI作为工具来修补现有系统。

title: Dynamic Competition for Sleepy Deposits
affiliations: Harvard University - Business School (HBS), University of Chicago, Harvard Business School, Harvard University and Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business

detail.title: Dynamic Competition for Sleepy Deposits
detail.abstract:
We examine the implications of sleepy deposits and their impact on competition, bank value, and financial stability in the US banking sector. We first document the shopping behavior of depositors using novel data on account openings and closures. Depositors infrequently shop for deposits, with 5–15% of depositors opening a new account each year. Shopping behavior is idiosyncratic: deposit accounts are more likely to be closed due to the depositor either moving or dying than because the depositor switched to a new account offering higher rates or better services. Building on these facts, we develop an empirical model of the supply and demand for "sleepy deposits." In the model, banks face dynamic "invest-versus-harvest" incentives in competing for depositors who shop infrequently. We estimate the model and find that depositor sleepiness accounts for 58% of the average bank’s deposit franchise value. Sleepiness softens competition, particularly raising markups and franchise value for banks in low-concentration areas, as well as for banks with either low-quality deposit services or high marginal costs. Sleepiness also creates stability in the banking sector. For two main money center banks in the US, the probability of default after the Federal Reserve's 2022-2023 hiking cycle would have increased to more than 20% in a counterfactual without sleepy depositors.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了"沉睡存款"对美国银行业竞争、银行价值和金融稳定的影响。研究发现存款人很少主动寻找新存款账户，这种"沉睡"行为导致银行竞争减弱，提高了银行的特许权价值，同时也增强了金融稳定性。
AI.research_question: 沉睡存款如何影响银行业的竞争、银行价值和金融稳定性？
AI.motivation: 理解存款人的行为模式及其对银行业竞争和稳定的系统性影响，这对于监管政策和银行战略制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于存款人购物行为的实证模型，构建了银行"投资与收割"的动态激励机制理论框架。
AI.method: 使用新颖的账户开立和关闭数据，开发并估计了沉睡存款供需的实证模型。
AI.findings: 存款人沉睡行为占银行平均存款特许权价值的58%；沉睡行为削弱了竞争，特别是在低集中度地区的银行、低质量存款服务或高边际成本的银行中提高了利润和特许权价值；沉睡行为还增强了金融稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了存款人沉睡行为对银行业竞争和稳定的理论框架，丰富了银行竞争理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行战略制定和监管政策提供了实证依据，特别是在利率上升周期中评估银行风险方面具有重要实践价值。

title: Where Collateral Sleeps
affiliations: Yale School of Management, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Where Collateral Sleeps
detail.abstract:
Banks can use the discount window to fend off a run by prepositioning assets with the Fed and borrowing against them. Following the March 2023 bank runs, policymakers have considered mandatory prepositioning, arguably the largest update to the lenderof-last-resort toolkit in over a century. We study the forces that shape the largest banks’ prepositioning. We show that run-prone uninsured-deposit flows causally drive prepositioning and that banks face a prepositioning stigma, even absent borrowing. Prepositioning is no panacea—banks still need good assets to borrow against—but it can help at the margin.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 银行可以通过预置资产向美联储贴现窗口借款来防范挤兑风险。研究发现，易受挤兑的无保险存款流动是预置资产的主要驱动因素，且银行面临预置污名效应。预置并非万能药，但能在边际上帮助应对挤兑风险。
AI.research_question: 影响大型银行预置资产决策的因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 2023年3月银行挤兑事件后，政策制定者考虑强制预置资产，这可能是超过一个世纪以来最后贷款人工具包的最大更新
AI.theoretical_framework: 最后贷款人理论、银行挤兑理论、污名效应理论
AI.method: 实证分析大型银行的预置行为与无保险存款流动的因果关系
AI.findings: 易受挤兑的无保险存款流动是预置资产的主要驱动因素；银行面临预置污名效应，即使没有实际借款；预置资产并非万能解决方案，但能在边际上帮助应对挤兑风险
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对最后贷款人工具使用行为的理解，揭示了预置污名效应的存在
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计强制预置政策提供实证依据，帮助银行更好地管理流动性风险

title: Drivers of Digital Payment Adoption: Lessons from Brazil, Costa Rica, and Mexico
affiliations: Yale University, Yale University, Central Bank of Costa Rica and Yale University

detail.title: Drivers of Digital Payment Adoption: Lessons from Brazil, Costa Rica, and Mexico
detail.abstract:
Digital payment platforms can displace cash and extend financial services to underserved populations, yet many adults worldwide remain unbanked. Leveraging granular microdata on individual transactions and user characteristics, we argue that broad cash substitution via peer-to-peer (P2P) platforms depends on a “rapid low income-gradient”, the speed at which adoption spreads from affluent early users to lower-income groups. In three Latin American cases, Brazil’s Pix, Costa Rica’s Sinpe Móvil, and Mexico’s CoDi, we document that low adoption costs, strong network effects, coordinated supply-side integration, and early awareness efforts enabled Pix and Sinpe Móvil to reach nearly all income segments within five years, whereas CoDi remains characterized by low usage and predominantly high-income adopters.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了三个拉丁美洲数字支付平台（巴西Pix、哥斯达黎加Sinpe Móvil、墨西哥CoDi）的采用模式，发现成功的现金替代需要"快速低收入梯度"，即从富裕早期用户快速扩展到低收入群体的速度。
AI.research_question: 数字支付平台如何实现广泛的现金替代并扩展到服务不足的人群？成功的现金替代需要哪些条件？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字支付平台有潜力替代现金并为服务不足人群提供金融服务，但全球仍有大量成年人没有银行账户，需要理解成功扩展的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用梯度理论、网络效应理论、技术扩散理论
AI.method: 基于三个拉丁美洲案例的微观交易数据和用户特征分析，采用比较案例研究方法
AI.findings: Pix和Sinpe Móvil通过低采用成本、强网络效应、协调的供给侧整合和早期意识努力，在五年内覆盖了几乎所有收入群体；而CoDi仍以低使用率和高收入采用者为主
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"快速低收入梯度"概念，丰富了技术扩散理论，特别是关于数字支付平台如何扩展到低收入群体的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和支付平台运营商提供了成功扩展数字支付的具体策略建议，特别是在发展中国家推广普惠金融的实践指导

title: The Downside of Fertility
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: The Downside of Fertility
detail.abstract:
The fertility decline is everywhere in the world today. Moreover, the decline goes decades back in the histories of rich countries. Birthrates have been below replacement in the U.S. and Europe since the mid-1970s, although further declines occurred after the Great Recession. The reasons for the declines from the 1970s to the early 2000s involve greater female autonomy and a mismatch between the desires of men and women. Men benefit more from maintaining traditions; women benefit more from eschewing them. When the probability is low that men will abandon traditions, some career women will not have children and others will delay, often too long. The fertility histories of the U.S. and those of many European and Asian countries speak to the impact of the mismatch on birth rates. The experience of middle income and even poorer nations may also be due to related factors. Various constraints that I group under matching problems have caused fertility to be lower than otherwise and imply that fertility has a “downside.”

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨全球生育率下降现象，分析从1970年代到21世纪初生育率下降的原因，主要关注女性自主权增强以及男女需求不匹配对生育率的影响。
AI.research_question: 全球生育率持续下降的根本原因是什么？特别是从1970年代到21世纪初生育率下降的主要驱动因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内生育率普遍下降，发达国家自1970年代中期以来生育率一直低于更替水平，这一现象需要深入理解其背后的社会和经济机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于性别角色理论、女性自主权理论和匹配问题理论，探讨传统性别角色与现代女性职业发展之间的冲突对生育决策的影响。
AI.method: 通过分析美国、欧洲和亚洲国家的生育历史数据，结合理论分析来检验性别角色不匹配对生育率的影响。
AI.findings: 生育率下降的主要原因是女性自主权增强和男女需求不匹配。男性更倾向于维持传统角色，而女性更倾向于摆脱传统，当男性不太可能放弃传统时，职业女性会选择不生育或推迟生育。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了匹配问题理论框架来解释生育率下降，强调性别角色不匹配是影响生育决策的关键因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解生育率下降的新视角，有助于设计更有效的生育支持政策，特别是针对性别角色平等和女性职业发展的政策。

title: Moving for Good: Educational Gains from Leaving Violence Behind
affiliations: University of Tennessee, Knoxville - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics and University of Florida

detail.title: Moving for Good: Educational Gains from Leaving Violence Behind
detail.abstract:
This paper estimates the effects of moving away from violent environments into safer areas on migrants' academic achievement in the context of the Mexican war on drugs. Using student location choices across space and over time, we recover individual-level migration paths for elementary school students across all municipalities in Mexico. We find that students who were induced to leave violent areas due to increased violence experience academic gains after relocating to safer areas. Students who migrated from municipalities in the 90th percentile of the violence distribution to municipalities in the 10th percentile experienced improvements of 5.3 percent of a standard deviation in their test scores two years after they migrated. These results appear to be explained by increases in school attendance and improvements in the learning environment after they moved.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了墨西哥毒品战争背景下，从暴力环境迁移到安全地区对移民学生学业成绩的影响。研究发现，因暴力增加而被迫离开的学生在搬迁到更安全地区后学业成绩有所提高。
AI.research_question: 从暴力环境迁移到安全地区对移民学生学业成绩有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究墨西哥毒品战争背景下，暴力环境对学生教育的影响，以及迁移到安全地区是否能改善学业表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境压力理论、教育迁移理论、暴力对学习环境的影响机制
AI.method: 利用学生地理位置选择数据，追踪墨西哥所有城市的小学生个体迁移路径，通过暴力分布百分位比较分析迁移效果
AI.findings: 从暴力分布90百分位城市迁移到10百分位城市的学生，在迁移两年后测试成绩提高了5.3%的标准差，主要归因于出勤率提高和学习环境改善
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境暴力对教育影响的机制提供了实证证据，深化了对迁移教育效应的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了迁移政策对教育影响的量化依据，有助于制定更有效的教育干预措施

title: How Do Financial Conditions Affect Professional Conduct? Evidence from Opioid Prescriptions
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Finance, New York University, Stern School of Business and Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business

detail.title: How Do Financial Conditions Affect Professional Conduct? Evidence from Opioid Prescriptions
detail.abstract:
We examine how healthcare providers’ opioid prescriptions are affected by changes in their home values, which proxy for shocks to their wealth. We find that providers increase opioid prescriptions when experiencing adverse financial conditions. Results are robust to including provider office–year fixed effects and using the subsample of providers who live far away from their offices, thereby largely ruling out a patient–demand explanation. Providers living in ZIP codes with price changes in the bottom half in 2007–2009 increased their opioid prescriptions in 2010–2012 by approximately 16% more than others. The effect is stronger among providers facing more provider competition and those serving vulnerable populations. Providers experiencing adverse financial conditions also receive more opioid-related payments from pharmaceutical companies. We also extend our analysis to ADHD medications, demonstrating a similar pattern of increased prescriptions under negative financial shocks, suggesting broader implications for other medical decisions. Our findings offer novel insights into professional conduct under personal financial pressure, with implications extending beyond healthcare.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 医疗提供者在个人财富受到负面冲击（如房价下跌）时会增加阿片类药物处方量，这一效应在面临更激烈竞争和服务弱势群体的提供者中更明显，且类似模式也出现在ADHD药物处方中
AI.research_question: 医疗提供者的个人财务状况如何影响其处方行为？具体而言，房价变化代表的财富冲击如何影响阿片类药物处方决策？
AI.motivation: 理解医疗专业人员在面临个人财务压力时的职业行为变化，这对医疗质量和患者安全具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、代理理论、医疗决策理论
AI.method: 使用2007-2012年医疗提供者数据，通过房价变化作为财富冲击的代理变量，采用双重差分法和固定效应模型分析处方行为变化
AI.findings: 1. 经历负面财务冲击的提供者阿片类药物处方量增加约16%；2. 效应在竞争激烈地区和服务弱势群体的提供者中更强；3. 类似模式出现在ADHD药物处方中；4. 财务困难的提供者从制药公司获得更多相关支付
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示医疗专业人员个人财务压力对处方决策的影响机制，扩展了行为经济学在医疗领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗监管政策提供新视角，提示需要关注医疗提供者个人财务状况对专业判断的潜在影响，有助于改善患者安全和医疗质量

title: Measuring Market Power in Network-Constrained Markets
affiliations: New York University and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: Measuring Market Power in Network-Constrained Markets
detail.abstract:
Producers in locational pricing markets have the ability to exercise market power by impacting the extent to which transport capacity constraints bind. We extend the single-location residual demand curve concept to a residual demand hypersurface that quantifies the impact of a supplier’s output change at one location on prices at all locations. This concept improves our ability to explain the offers suppliers submit in the Italian locational pricing electricity market and demonstrates why the locations of a firm’s generation capacity determines the size and direction of locational price changes associated with the divestment of a fixed amount of generation capacity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文将单点剩余需求曲线概念扩展到剩余需求超曲面，用于量化供应商在某一地点的产量变化对所有地点价格的影响，并解释了意大利位置定价电力市场中供应商报价行为以及公司发电容量位置如何决定固定容量剥离带来的位置价格变化的大小和方向。
AI.research_question: 生产商在位置定价市场中如何通过影响运输容量约束的绑定程度来行使市场权力？
AI.motivation: 传统单点剩余需求曲线无法完全解释位置定价市场中的市场权力行使机制，需要发展新的分析框架来理解供应商在不同地点的产量决策对全网价格的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 位置定价理论、市场权力理论、剩余需求曲线理论
AI.method: 将单点剩余需求曲线扩展为剩余需求超曲面概念，应用于意大利位置定价电力市场的实证分析
AI.findings: 剩余需求超曲面概念能更好地解释供应商在意大利电力市场的报价行为，并证明公司发电容量的地理位置决定了固定容量剥离带来的位置价格变化的大小和方向
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了剩余需求超曲面理论框架，扩展了市场权力分析工具，为位置定价市场中的市场权力研究提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场监管机构提供了新的分析工具，有助于识别和监管位置定价市场中的市场权力滥用行为，对电力市场设计和监管政策具有重要参考价值

title: More Girls, Fewer Blues: Peer Gender Ratios and Adolescent Mental Health
affiliations: Syracuse University and Syracuse University

detail.title: More Girls, Fewer Blues: Peer Gender Ratios and Adolescent Mental Health
detail.abstract:
Using individual-level data from the Add Health surveys, we leverage idiosyncratic variation in gender composition across cohorts within the same school to examine whether being exposed to a higher share of female peers affects mental health and school satisfaction. We find that being exposed to a higher proportion of female peers, despite only improving school satisfaction for boys, improves mental health for both boys and girls. The benefits are greater among boys of low socioeconomic backgrounds, who would otherwise be more likely to be exposed to violent and disruptive peers. We find suggestive evidence that the mechanisms driving our findings are consistent with stronger school friendships for boys and better self-image and grades for girls.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 使用Add Health调查数据，研究发现：在同一个学校内，当学生接触到更高比例的女性同龄人时，尽管只提高了男生的学校满意度，但改善了男生和女生的心理健康。对低社会经济背景的男生益处更大，机制可能涉及男生更强的学校友谊和女生更好的自我形象与成绩。
AI.research_question: 接触更高比例的女性同龄人是否会影响学生的心理健康和学校满意度？
AI.motivation: 探讨学校性别构成对学生心理健康的潜在影响，特别关注不同性别和社会经济背景学生的差异效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同伴效应理论，研究性别构成对心理健康的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用Add Health调查的个体层面数据，采用同一学校内不同队列间性别构成的异质性变化进行分析。
AI.findings: 接触更高比例的女性同龄人改善了男生和女生的心理健康，但只提高了男生的学校满意度；对低社会经济背景的男生益处更大；机制可能涉及男生更强的学校友谊和女生更好的自我形象与成绩。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对学校性别构成影响心理健康机制的理解，揭示了不同性别学生受益的不同路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校性别平衡政策提供了实证依据，特别有助于改善弱势背景学生的心理健康状况。

title: Why Don’t Struggling Students Do Their Homework? Disentangling Motivation and Study Productivity as Drivers of Human Capital Formation
affiliations: Queen's University, Department of Economics, Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School, University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Brigham Young University and Australian National University (ANU)

detail.title: Why Don’t Struggling Students Do Their Homework? Disentangling Motivation and Study Productivity as Drivers of Human Capital Formation
detail.abstract:
Using field-experimental data (study-time tracking and randomized incentives), we identify a structural model of learning. Student effort is influenced by external costs/benefits and unobserved heterogeneity: motivation (willingness to study) and productivity (conversion rate of time into skill). We estimate academic labor-supply elasticities and skill technology. Productivity and motivation are uncorrelated. Low productivity, not low motivation, is the stronger predictor of academic struggles. School quality augments productivity and accelerates skill production. We find that dynamic skill complementarities arise mainly from children’s aging and from a feedback loop between investment activity and productivity, rather than from carrying forward past skill stocks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实地实验数据构建学习结构模型，发现学生努力受外部成本/收益和未观察异质性影响。低生产力（而非低动机）是学业困难的主要预测因素，学校质量能提升生产力并加速技能生产。
AI.research_question: 学生学习的结构模型是什么？影响学生努力和学业表现的关键因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 理解学生学习过程中的关键驱动因素，特别是外部激励与内在异质性（动机和生产力）如何影响学业表现
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习结构模型、学术劳动力供给理论、技能生产技术理论
AI.method: 实地实验数据（学习时间追踪和随机激励）、结构模型估计
AI.findings: 1）生产力与动机不相关；2）低生产力（而非低动机）是学业困难的主要预测因素；3）学校质量提升生产力并加速技能生产；4）动态技能互补性主要来自儿童年龄增长和投资活动与生产力的反馈循环
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了学习结构模型，识别了学术劳动力供给弹性，阐明了动态技能互补性的来源机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定提供实证依据，强调提升学校质量和学生生产力的重要性

title: Prescription for Disaster: The SSDI Rate, Pain, and Prescribing Practices
affiliations: University of Notre Dame and University of Notre Dame

detail.title: Prescription for Disaster: The SSDI Rate, Pain, and Prescribing Practices

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was approved by the University of Notre Dame IRB: protocol ID 24-01-8323.

detail.abstract:
A county’s fraction of adults in 1990 on Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) is a strong predictor of growth in local drug death rates after 2000. The part of the SSDI rate related to drug deaths is not proxying for well-known contributors to the drug crisis, e.g. OxyContin. Instead, it appears to capture the fraction of people in chronic pain. We show that in the late 1990s, physicians began prescribing opioids more aggressively to treat pain. Taken together, our estimates suggest that drug deaths rates would be 43% lower in 2015 had prescribing practices stayed at 1995 levels.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 1990年一个县的成年人中领取社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）的比例是预测2000年后当地药物死亡增长率的有力指标。与药物死亡相关的SSDI率并非替代已知的药物危机因素（如奥施康定），而是反映了慢性疼痛人群的比例。研究表明，1990年代末医生开始更积极地使用阿片类药物治疗疼痛，如果处方实践保持在1995年水平，2015年的药物死亡率将降低43%。
AI.research_question: SSDI率与药物死亡率增长之间的关系是什么？这种关系是否反映了慢性疼痛人群对阿片类药物处方的敏感性？
AI.motivation: 理解药物死亡危机的根本原因，特别是识别除了已知因素（如奥施康定）之外的其他重要预测变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗处方行为变化与公共卫生结果之间的因果关系框架，探讨SSDI率作为慢性疼痛代理变量对阿片类药物危机的解释力。
AI.method: 使用县级面板数据，分析1990年SSDI率与2000年后药物死亡率增长的关系，控制其他已知影响因素。
AI.findings: SSDI率是药物死亡率增长的有力预测指标，主要反映了慢性疼痛人群对阿片类药物处方的敏感性。如果1990年代末的处方实践没有变得更加积极，2015年的药物死亡率将显著降低43%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SSDI率作为慢性疼痛代理变量的新视角，丰富了药物危机成因的理论解释，强调了医疗处方行为变化的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对慢性疼痛人群的药物滥用预防策略依据，强调了控制阿片类药物处方的重要性。

title: Asset Elasticities and Currency Risk Transfer
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Goethe University Frankfurt, Brown University, , Deutsche Bundesbank and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Asset Elasticities and Currency Risk Transfer
detail.abstract:
We use administrative security-level data from the U.S. and Euro Area (EA) portfolios to estimate asset demand and supply elasticities by exploiting exogenous variation in bond-specific currency wedges. Employing a Bartik-style shift-share identification approach, we document extensive heterogeneity in investor demand responsiveness to exogenous changes in the price of currency risk, conditional on the issuer characteristics. Demand for AE-bonds is always inelastic, whereas for EM-bonds, elasticity depends on investor type and currency: insurance/pension, nonbanks and banks have finite-elastic demand for EM-bonds that are issued in their own (investor) currency. For EM-issuer-currency bonds, only EA non-bank investors increase the share of these bonds in their portfolio when currency wedges widen, suggesting they accept higher currency risk for higher returns. In response, issuers adjust their supply endogenously: an exogenous increase of 8 basis point in currency wedges leads to a 0.26% decline in local currency bond issuance relative to GDP. We develop a theoretical framework where debt issuance decisions take into account heterogenous demand of investors in terms of their response to changes in the price of currency risk.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国和欧元区投资组合数据，通过债券特定货币楔子的外生变化估计资产需求和供给弹性，发现投资者对货币风险价格变化的反应存在显著异质性，特别是新兴市场债券的需求弹性取决于投资者类型和货币种类。
AI.research_question: 投资者对货币风险价格变化的资产需求弹性如何？发行者如何内生调整债券供给？
AI.motivation: 理解不同投资者类型对货币风险的反应差异，以及这种异质性需求如何影响债券发行决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bartik风格的移-份额识别方法，构建考虑投资者异质性货币风险反应的理论框架。
AI.method: 利用美国和欧元区行政安全级别数据，通过债券特定货币楔子的外生变化，采用Bartik式识别策略估计需求弹性。
AI.findings: 发达经济体债券需求始终缺乏弹性；新兴市场债券弹性取决于投资者类型和货币：保险/养老金、非银行和银行对以投资者本币发行的EM债券具有有限弹性；只有EA非银行投资者在货币楔子扩大时增加EM发行者货币债券份额；发行者内生调整供给：货币楔子外生增加8个基点导致本地货币债券发行相对GDP下降0.26%。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑投资者对货币风险价格变化异质性反应的理论框架，将债务发行决策与投资者需求特征联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了关于货币风险传导机制和债券市场动态的重要见解，有助于理解国际资本流动和汇率风险定价。

title: Climate Risk Exposure and Firms’ Climate Strategies
affiliations: London Business School and Columbia University

detail.title: Climate Risk Exposure and Firms’ Climate Strategies
detail.abstract:
When exposed to greater physical and transition climate risks, are firms more likely to engage in climate mitigation, climate adaptation, or/and political strategies? This study examines this question and finds that firms exposed to greater physical and transition climate risks are less likely to undertake substantial mitigation efforts. Instead, they pursue other strategies. Specifically, firms exposed to greater physical climate risks are more inclined to pursue adaptation strategies, while firms facing higher transition climate risks are more likely to engage in anti-climate political strategies (such as lobbying against climate policies). The intensity of how firms manage their climate risks is influenced by their time horizon: the more myopic they are, the less they engage in climate mitigation and the more they oppose climate-friendly policies, thereby decreasing transition risks today while worsening their exposure to future physical and transition climate risks. Overall, this study provides insights into the (lack of) preparedness of the corporate sector for heightened climate risks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业在面临物理和转型气候风险时的应对策略，发现企业倾向于采取适应策略或政治策略而非实质性减排措施，且企业的短期主义倾向会影响其风险管理强度。
AI.research_question: 当企业面临更大的物理和转型气候风险时，它们更可能采取气候减缓、气候适应和/或政治策略中的哪些策略？
AI.motivation: 了解企业部门对日益加剧的气候风险的（缺乏）准备情况
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候风险管理理论、企业战略响应理论、时间视野理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法（具体方法未在摘要中详细说明）
AI.findings: 1. 面临更大物理气候风险的企业更倾向于采取适应策略；2. 面临更高转型气候风险的企业更可能参与反气候政治策略；3. 企业的短期主义倾向会减少气候减缓努力并增加对气候友好政策的反对
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型气候风险下企业的差异化战略选择，以及时间视野在气候风险管理中的调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业气候风险管理提供决策参考，为政策制定者理解企业应对行为提供洞见

title: When Will Entrepreneurs Choose to Make Themselves Replaceable?
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: When Will Entrepreneurs Choose to Make Themselves Replaceable?
detail.abstract:
This paper examines when and why entrepreneurs choose to standardise their ventures and make themselves replaceable, extending Rajan's (2012) analysis within a property rights framework. A model is developed where entrepreneurs face finite pools of potential replacements and may remain with their ventures post-IPO, rather than retiring as in Rajan's setting. The analysis yields two main results. First, when worker effort is fully contractible, entrepreneurs never choose to standardise, preferring to remain irreplaceable to maximise their bargaining power. Second, when key workers exert non-contractible effort that affects firm value, standardisation becomes beneficial as it motivates worker performance while managing the entrepreneur's replaceability. The optimal level of standardisation increases with the entrepreneur's equity stake, creating a ``dead zone" where entrepreneurs retain control but will not sell to outsiders. I extend the model to allow replacement of both entrepreneurs and workers, showing that standardisation can serve to reduce the bargaining power of all participants. The findings provide testable predictions about the relationship between equity structures, replacement market depth, and organisational design choices, while highlighting the strategic trade-offs entrepreneurs face between maintaining founder-specific advantages and creating transferable value for investors.

title: Interest Rate Caps and Bank Loan Supply: Locking out the Small Borrower in the Great Depression
affiliations: and Utah State University - Huntsman School of Business

detail.title: Interest Rate Caps and Bank Loan Supply: Locking out the Small Borrower in the Great Depression
detail.abstract:
We examine the effects of changes in an interest rate cap on small loan brokers in New Jersey during the Great Depression. Using newly constructed data on brokers and banks, we find that small loans declined sharply when the cap was lowered, and despite worsening economic conditions, they rebounded when the cap was raised back up. Consumers could not obtain alternative credit from banks, effectively shutting them out of the market. The cap had a permanent impact on the small loan market due to the large number of broker closures, thereby further reducing the availability of small loans and increasing market concentration. Our findings highlight the fundamental trade-off faced by policymakers: strict rate caps may protect borrowers from predatory lending but can eliminate necessary credit options for vulnerable populations.

title: Clean Rides, Healthy Lives: The Impact of Electric Vehicle Adoption on Air Quality and Infant Health
affiliations: Sabanci University, Yale University, Newcastle University and American University

detail.title: Clean Rides, Healthy Lives: The Impact of Electric Vehicle Adoption on Air Quality and Infant Health
detail.abstract:
This paper provides the first nationwide evidence on how electric vehicle (EV) adoption has improved both air quality and child health. We assemble a rich dataset from 2010–2021 that links county-level EV registrations to measures of air pollution, birth outcomes, and emergency department visits. The endogeneity of EV adoption is addressed using two complementary strategies: Two-way fixed effects and instrumental variables (IV). The IV exploits the staggered rollout of Alternative Fuel Corridors as a source of exogenous variation in charging infrastructure that affected EV adoption. The estimates show that greater EV penetration significantly reduces nitrogen dioxide (NO2), a key pollutant linked to vehicular emissions. These improvements in air quality yield significant health benefits, including reductions in very low birth weight and very premature births, as well as fewer asthma-related emergency department visits among children ages 0 to 5. This is true even when potentially offsetting increases in pollution from the electricity generation needed to power EVs are accounted for. The benefits are higher in the high-pollution counties with Alternative Fuel Corridors, where baseline exposures are greatest. The resulting reductions in very low birth weight births alone could generate annual benefits of $1.2 to $4.0 billion. These findings underscore the dual environmental and public health benefits of EV adoption.

title: Geopolitical Risk and Extreme Spillovers among Oil-based Energy Commodities
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - Institute of Economic Studies, Mendel University in Brno and Mendel University in Brno

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk and Extreme Spillovers among Oil-based Energy Commodities

keywords: global banks with high exposure to oil

detail.abstract: We investigate the impact and propagation of geopolitical risk among oil-based energy commodities. First, we endogenously identify key geopolitical events affecting the connectedness among the oil-based commodities and then evaluate their transitory and persistent impacts. We identify four major shocks that resulted in persistent shifts in connectedness: the 9/11 attacks, the Crimea crisis, the political shift in Nigeria, and the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Using a quantile-based framework, we demonstrate that volatility transmissions due to geopolitical risk are not uniform but significantly depend on market conditions. Notably, heating oil and crude oil are identified as primary transmitters of risk, especially during economic turmoil. We quantify the negative economic and financial impacts of geopolitical risks through a multivariate dynamic portfolio analysis and through an impact on the profitability of ten global banks with high exposure to oil commodities. Our findings enhance the understanding of how geopolitical shocks influence connectedness and informed portfolio decisions, highlighting the need for adaptive strategies in finance.

title: The Changing Nature of International Trade and its Implications for Development
affiliations: Yale University - Department of Economics and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: The Changing Nature of International Trade and its Implications for Development
detail.abstract:
This paper revisits the relationship between international trade, trade policy, and development in light of the structural, policy, and geopolitical shifts that have transformed globalization over the past decade. While trade has historically supported development through both static and dynamic channels, we argue that the latter—those inducing structural transformation and institutional change—have been far more consequential for long-run development. Through access to global markets, participation in global value chains, and knowledge and technology transfers, and by providing an anchor for reform, trade and trade agreements have contributed to productivity gains, technological progress, quality and skill upgrading, and institutional change in many low- and middle-income countries. Yet, the conditions that enabled these effects—technologically driven declines in transportation and communication costs, fragmentation of the production process, liberal trade regimes, multilateralism and geopolitical stability—are changing. Automation, digitization, climate change, the return of industrial policy in advanced economies, and the rise of geopolitical rivalry are reshaping the global trade environment. In this new context, the scope for replicating past export-led growth successes is unlikely as two key growth mechanisms, access to the lucrative markets of advanced economies and knowledge sharing, are under threat. We discuss whether trade in services and the green transition may offer new opportunities, emphasizing that future prospects will depend on policy choices in large economies and the adaptability of developing countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Supply-Side Opioid Restrictions and the Retail Pharmacy Market
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas and American University

detail.title: Supply-Side Opioid Restrictions and the Retail Pharmacy Market
detail.abstract:
While policymakers routinely limit the sale of goods thought to be of risk to public health, relatively less is known about whether and how these policies affect firm performance. Using 2000-2018 National Establishment Time-Series data and a difference-in-differences strategy, we show that state “pill mill” laws intended to reduce the overprescribing of opioids reduced retail pharmacy sales and employment. These reductions were most pronounced in highly competitive areas and for standalone pharmacies – two characteristics associated with pharmacy drug diversion. Meanwhile, pharmacies located across the border in states without a pill mill law experienced increases in sales and employment. Next, we show that state pill mill laws were associated with an increase in standalone pharmacy closures, though the total number of pharmacies was unchanged. Our results are consistent with these laws adversely affecting pharmacies filling inappropriate opioid prescriptions without meaningfully altering patient access to retail pharmacies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Political Capitalism vs the Public Interest: Influence in the Presence of Checks and Balances
affiliations: University of California - Department of Economics and Deakin University - School of Accounting, Economics and Finance

detail.title: Political Capitalism vs the Public Interest: Influence in the Presence of Checks and Balances
detail.abstract: We examine how political capitalism can develop within modern states that typically have many types of checks and balances. We first discuss how this can occur through various influence channels: government executive and regulatory agencies, legislators, litigation, the press, and the public sphere more generally. We then develop a model in which a group representing the public interest competes for policy implementation with a group that seeks private advantage. A non-venal decision maker makes the policy decision based on the lobbying of the two groups, which is partly restrained by an existing, status-quo policy and by the decision maker’s expertise. Because of free-rider problems but also because of a greater ability to develop a lobbying infrastructure, the group seeking private advantage has a better chance of implementing its policy even when the status quo policy is aligned with the public interest. Only when the decision maker has a high enough level of expertise and favorable status quo policy does the public interest group have a better chance of winning.

title: Firm Capacity Underutilization and the Measurement of Productivity
