detail.title: Firm Capacity Underutilization and the Measurement of Productivity
detail.abstract:
When estimating a production function, economists usually assume that firms fully employ all their available inputs. Contrary to this assumption, we document that underemployment of quasi-fixed inputs or low capacity utilization rates (CUR) is common across firms, especially in poor countries. Low CURs are correlated with supply-side constraints such as shortages of material inputs and electricity; they are also correlated with demand-side constraints such as a lack of access to markets. We show that when firms underemploy their quasi-fixed inputs, the assumptions behind standard production function estimation techniques-such as the control function approach-are invalid, and these techniques produce biased estimates of TFP. We demonstrate this using unique panel data from Ethiopia with information on actual and full capacity input demand. We find that measures of TFP that do not account for CUR considerably underestimate ’true’ productivity when CUR is low but not when CUR is high. This leads to an exaggeration of the TFP gap between rich and poor countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现企业普遍存在产能利用率不足的问题，特别是在贫困国家。当企业未能充分利用准固定投入时，传统的生产率估算方法会产生偏差，导致低估贫困国家的真实生产率，从而夸大贫富国家间的生产率差距。
AI.research_question: 企业产能利用率不足如何影响全要素生产率（TFP）的估算准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学假设企业完全利用所有可用投入，但现实中企业普遍存在产能利用率不足的问题，特别是在贫困国家，这可能导致TFP估算偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产函数理论、产能利用率理论、控制函数方法
AI.method: 使用埃塞俄比亚独特的面板数据，包含实际和满负荷投入需求信息，分析产能利用率对TFP估算的影响。
AI.findings: 不考虑产能利用率的TFP测量方法在产能利用率低时会显著低估真实生产率，但在产能利用率高时不会；这导致贫富国家间的TFP差距被夸大。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统生产函数估算的基本假设，提出了考虑产能利用率的更准确TFP测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的生产率评估工具，有助于更有效地制定经济发展政策。

title: Riding to Opportunity: Geographic and Household Effects from the Orphan Trains
affiliations: Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge - Department of Economics and Louisiana State University

detail.title: Riding to Opportunity: Geographic and Household Effects from the Orphan Trains
detail.abstract:
Between 1854 and 1929, approximately 200,000 children were transported from East Coast cities to new homes in the American West, motivated by the theory that a change of geography and household environment can transform lives. We leverage quasi-experimental variation in child placements to evaluate both whether being sent West improved outcomes relative to remaining in New York institutions, and whether variation in destination and foster household characteristics affected later life success. Linking tens of thousands of ``orphan train'' riders and comparable non-relocated children to Census records through 1940, we find no systematic evidence that relocation itself improved adult economic outcomes. Among children sent West, substantial variation in county-level economic opportunities also did not predict adult success. In contrast, the individual foster household income predicts children's later incomes, with an estimated intergenerational elasticity of about 0.2.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1854-1929年间美国"孤儿列车"计划的效果，发现搬迁本身并不能改善儿童成年后的经济状况，但寄养家庭的收入对儿童未来收入有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 被送往西部的儿童是否比留在纽约机构的儿童有更好的经济结果？目的地和寄养家庭特征如何影响儿童未来的成功？
AI.motivation: 基于"改变地理和家庭环境可以改变生活"的理论，评估历史上大规模儿童迁移计划的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理环境改变理论、寄养家庭影响理论、代际流动性理论
AI.method: 利用准实验变异，将数万名"孤儿列车"乘客与未搬迁儿童进行匹配，并链接到1940年的人口普查记录进行分析
AI.findings: 搬迁本身不能改善成人经济结果；县级经济机会差异不影响结果；寄养家庭收入显著预测儿童未来收入（代际弹性约0.2）
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了单纯改变地理环境就能改善生活的理论，强调家庭环境的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童福利政策提供实证依据，强调寄养家庭质量而非地理位置的重要性

title: The EUʼs New Expenditure Rule and Its Implications for Monetary Policy
affiliations: Athens University of Economics and Business, Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of International and European Economic Studies and Athens University of Economics and Business - Department of Economics

detail.title: The EUʼs New Expenditure Rule and Its Implications for Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the new expenditure rule of the European Union (EU) can restore dynamic stability and determinacy with bounded public debt in an otherwise unstable economic environment. We build upon the standard New Keynesian dynamic general equilibrium model so as to compare our results to the well-known results of Leeper (1991, 2016) and, more generally, to the literature on the fiscal-monetary policy mix. We find that the EUís new fiscal rule, despite its intentions, works practically like active fiscal policy. Given this, it does not leave room for active monetary (interest rate) policy; instead, the central bank has to accommodate the active fiscal policy which means that the policy interest rate can react only weakly to inflation. This will undermine the ECB's key mandate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现欧盟新财政规则实际上类似于积极的财政政策，限制了欧洲央行的货币政策空间，使其只能对通胀做出弱反应，从而可能削弱ECB的核心使命。
AI.research_question: 欧盟新支出规则是否能在不稳定的经济环境中恢复动态稳定性和有界公共债务的确定性？
AI.motivation: 评估欧盟新财政规则对财政-货币政策组合的影响，特别是对欧洲央行货币政策操作空间的限制作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于标准新凯恩斯动态一般均衡模型，与Leeper（1991，2016）及财政-货币政策组合文献进行比较。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，使用动态一般均衡框架评估财政规则对政策组合的影响。
AI.findings: 欧盟新财政规则实际上运作类似积极财政政策，限制了货币政策空间，要求央行只能对通胀做出弱反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了财政规则设计对货币政策独立性的约束机制，丰富了财政-货币政策协调理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟财政规则改革提供重要政策启示，警示其对欧洲央行通胀目标实现能力的潜在负面影响。

reference: University of Michigan Journal of Law Reform, Vol. 58, pp. 547–554, 2025
title: Introduction: The Future of Agency Independence Symposium
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Introduction: The Future of Agency Independence Symposium

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Michigan Journal of Law Reform, Vol. 58, pp. 547–554, 2025

detail.abstract:
On the Friday after the election last November, the student editors and I convened scholars from across the country at the University of Michigan Law School to discuss the future of agency independence. The goal was to center our discussion on the traditional unitary executive debate and then look beyond statutory restrictions on the President’s removal power to explore other contours of agency independence in modern regulatory governance. Those included the role of scientific expertise and politics in agency decision-making, the decisional independence of agency adjudicators, and the importance of a professionalized civil service. When we planned the symposium, we did not know who would win the presidential election. Nor could we have predicted the extent that these aspects of agency independence would be affected by a new administration.

In retrospect, this Future of Agency Independence Symposium could not have been more prescient. The important conversions that started at the in-person symposium and that continue in the pages of this symposium issue of the Journal of Law Reform make meaningful contributions to the literature and debates on the future of agency independence. And they will no doubt spark further conversations as well as doctrinal, empirical, normative, and theoretical scholarship that will shape the response to the second Trump Administration’s actions and the Supreme Court’s reply.

To introduce this symposium issue, I separate these conversations into the four panels that took place at the in-person symposium.

AI.tldr: 该论文是对密歇根大学法学院举办的"机构独立性未来"研讨会的介绍，讨论了总统选举后机构独立性的多个维度，包括科学专业知识与政治在决策中的作用、机构裁决者的决策独立性以及职业化公务员制度的重要性。
AI.research_question: 现代监管治理中机构独立性的未来发展方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 在总统选举后，探讨机构独立性在传统单一行政辩论之外的多个维度，包括科学专业知识与政治的平衡、机构裁决者的独立性以及职业化公务员制度的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统单一行政理论，扩展到现代监管治理中机构独立性的多维度理论框架。
AI.method: 通过学术研讨会的形式，汇集全国学者进行讨论，并将讨论内容整理为专题期刊文章。
AI.findings: 研讨会讨论对机构独立性的文献和辩论做出了有意义的贡献，并将引发进一步的对话和学术研究，以应对新政府行动和最高法院的回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了机构独立性的理论讨论，超越了传统的单一行政辩论，涵盖了科学专业知识、政治平衡、裁决独立性和公务员职业化等多个维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对新政府时期机构独立性的实际挑战提供了学术讨论平台，并为政策制定者和学者提供了理论指导和实践启示。

title: There Goes the Neighborhood? The Local Impacts of State Policies That Override Municipal Zoning
affiliations: Rutgers University and Mathematica, Inc.

detail.title: There Goes the Neighborhood? The Local Impacts of State Policies That Override Municipal Zoning
detail.abstract: Prior research shows that restrictive zoning regulations are major drivers of rising housing costs and residential segregation in the United States. In response, a growing number of state and local governments are passing laws to allow for denser housing in strictly zoned municipalities, despite entrenched opposition from incumbent residents. This paper examines whether incumbent residents’ responses undermine the success of these policies by studying new construction permitted under Massachusetts Chapter 40B; one of the longest-standing and most productive examples of a housing policy that bypasses local zoning laws. Exploiting hyperlocal variation in residents’ proximity to new 40B buildings, we find that only a subset of larger 40B developments cause property values to decrease, and that this effect is both highly localized and only emerges in the longer term, many years after these developments are proposed. Focusing on these larger developments that are more likely to elicit resident reactions, we find that only a fraction of incumbent residents move out after their approval and that the magnitude of these migration responses is insufficient to undermine policymakers’ desegregation goals. We also do not find evidence that incumbent residents become more politically active against future development, as they are no more likely to vote in local or general elections nor are they more likely to vote for repealing Chapter 40B after 40B developments are proposed near their homes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了马萨诸塞州第40B章住房政策下新建住房对现有居民反应的影响，发现大型开发项目仅在长期内导致局部房价下降，但居民的迁移反应和政治活动变化不足以破坏政策目标。
AI.research_question: 现有居民对绕过地方分区法的住房政策的反应是否会破坏这些政策的成功实施？
AI.motivation: 限制性分区法规是美国住房成本上升和居住隔离的主要驱动因素，但现有居民对新开发项目的反对可能影响政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房经济学和居民行为反应理论，分析政策干预对居民迁移和政治参与的影响。
AI.method: 利用马萨诸塞州第40B章政策下的新建住房数据，采用超局部变异分析方法，研究居民距离新开发项目的远近对其行为的影响。
AI.findings: 只有较大型的40B开发项目在长期内导致局部房价下降；现有居民的迁移反应有限，不足以破坏政策目标；居民在政策实施后并未增加政治活动或反对未来开发。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了居民对住房政策的行为反应具有局部性和长期性，挑战了居民强烈反对会直接破坏政策效果的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了证据，表明即使面临居民反对，绕过地方分区法的住房政策仍可能有效实现住房供给和减隔目标。

title: Gender Differences in University Enrollment and STEM Major: The Role of Tuition Policy in Australia
affiliations: McMaster University - Department of Economics, University of Melbourne - Melbourne Institute: Applied Economic & Social Research and University of Melbourne - Melbourne Institute: Applied Economic & Social Research

detail.title: Gender Differences in University Enrollment and STEM Major: The Role of Tuition Policy in Australia
detail.abstract: We analyze whether men and women respond differently to tuition variation for both university entry and STEM major choice, using a 30-year Australian individual-level administrative dataset. The Australian setting is unique: tuition fees are regulated, students can defer payment through income-contingent loans, and universities receive discipline-specific government subsidies. We find women consistently enrolled at higher rates than men, on average 14 percentage points between 1991 and 2020, with the gap widening over the period from 10 to 16 percentage points. By contrast, men were more likely to register in STEM fields. This STEM gap has remained stable in traditional STEM disciplines, but the gap has narrowed since 2005 when including Health in the definition of STEM. We find that women respond more positively than men to tuition increases in terms of overall enrollment. Effects on STEM participation, however, are less clear and vary across time. The STEM choice patterns suggest systematic gender differences in incentives and behavior, reflecting factors such as men’s stronger engagement with higher-paying non-university jobs, higher expected returns to traditional STEM fields for men, narrower earnings dispersion for women across fields, and gender differences in cost sensitivity and risk aversion. Our findings highlight how tuition policy interacts with gender-specific incentives to shape both university enrollment and major choices.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用澳大利亚30年行政数据，分析男女对大学学费变化的反应差异，发现在大学入学率方面女性反应更积极，但在STEM专业选择上存在性别差异，反映了不同的激励因素和行为模式。
AI.research_question: 男性和女性对大学学费变化（包括大学入学和STEM专业选择）的反应是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 理解学费政策如何与性别特定的激励因素相互作用，影响大学入学和专业选择决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育经济学和性别差异理论，考虑预期回报、成本敏感性、风险规避等激励因素。
AI.method: 使用1991-2020年澳大利亚个体层面行政数据进行实证分析，考察学费变化对入学率和STEM专业选择的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 女性入学率平均比男性高14个百分点，且差距随时间扩大；2) 男性更可能选择STEM专业；3) 女性对学费上涨的整体入学反应更积极；4) STEM参与的影响随时间变化且不明确。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了学费政策与性别特定激励因素的复杂交互作用，为理解教育选择中的性别差异提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的学费政策提供了实证依据，强调了考虑性别差异的重要性。

title: Flexclusivity: Exclusive Agreements with Competitive Flexibility
affiliations: National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE) - Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST) and CREST-ENSAE

detail.title: Flexclusivity: Exclusive Agreements with Competitive Flexibility
detail.abstract: Sellers face a critical choice: run competitive auctions or strike exclusive deals with preferred buyers. Contrary to conventional wisdom that sellers should rely on open competition, we show that a powerful seller optimally commits to a sequential ‘flexclusivity’ arrangement –a strategic mix of exclusivity and competitive bidding. Under broad conditions, the seller chooses with positive probability to disregard alternative buyers entirely. We demonstrate, in a parsimonious model, that simple option contracts implement flexclusivity efficiently, increasing the expected joint profit of the contracting parties. When a preferred buyer declines the option, this credibly signals his weakness, allowing the seller to extract more rent from stronger buyers in subsequent auctions. The joint gain from such arrangements can represent as much as 75% of what vertical integration would achieve, without requiring commitment beyond the initial contracting stage.

AI.tldr: 卖方最优策略是采用'灵活排他性'安排——战略性地混合排他性交易和竞争性拍卖，通过简单期权合约实现效率提升，当首选买家拒绝期权时能有效信号传递其弱势地位，使卖方能从更强买家处获取更多租金
AI.research_question: 卖方如何在竞争性拍卖和排他性交易之间做出最优选择？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为卖方应依赖公开竞争，但本文挑战这一观点，探讨更优的战略安排
AI.theoretical_framework: 拍卖理论、合约理论、信号传递理论
AI.method: 简约模型分析，期权合约机制设计
AI.findings: 灵活排他性安排能提高合同各方的预期联合利润，联合收益可达纵向一体化收益的75%，且无需超出初始合同阶段的承诺
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'灵活排他性'新概念，挑战了传统竞争性拍卖最优的假设，发展了信号传递在合约设计中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为卖方提供了实用的合约策略，通过期权合约设计实现更优的租金提取

title: The Dynamics of Technology Transfer: Multinational Investment in China and Rising Global Competition
affiliations: Federal Reserve Board of Governors, International Monetary Fund (IMF), Independent and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: The Dynamics of Technology Transfer: Multinational Investment in China and Rising Global Competition
detail.abstract:
US multinationals formed joint ventures in China for market access and lower labor costs. However, these ventures transfer technology to Chinese firms, fueling future competition. While individual firms weigh the risks to their own profits, they disregard the negative impact on other US firms and the broader economy, resulting in an over-investment that may reduce the US welfare. In our empirical analysis, industries with more joint ventures in China show positive spillovers to Chinese firms but negative outcomes for firms in the US. We develop a two-country model with oligopolistic competition, innovation, and joint ventures. For the US, the short-run gains from joint ventures are outweighed by long-run losses due to rising Chinese competition. Joint ventures benefit large US firms at the expense of small firms and the real wages of workers. A ban on joint ventures since 1999 would have boosted US welfare by 1.2 percent.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国跨国公司在华合资企业带来短期利益但造成长期竞争威胁，导致美国福利净损失
AI.research_question: 美国跨国公司在中国的合资企业如何影响美国整体福利？
AI.motivation: 企业追求个体利润最大化时忽视了对其他美国企业和整体经济的负面影响，导致过度投资
AI.theoretical_framework: 双国家寡头竞争模型，包含创新和合资企业
AI.method: 实证分析结合理论建模，检验行业层面的溢出效应
AI.findings: 在华合资企业多的行业对中国企业有正向溢出效应，但对美国企业有负面结果；短期收益被长期损失所抵消
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业个体理性决策与集体福利之间的冲突，提供了合资企业外部性的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了合资禁令的福利效应（1.2%的福利提升），为政策制定提供依据

title: The Benchmarking Prisoner's Dilemma
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan

detail.title: The Benchmarking Prisoner's Dilemma
detail.abstract:
Benchmarking has long been a cornerstone of institutional investing, offering discipline, structure, and accountability. Yet as portfolios have evolved to include complex, multi-asset strategies, traditional benchmarking frameworks can unintentionally encourage cautious or narrowly focused behavior, limiting the potential for genuine long-term value creation. This paper applies insights from game theory and agency theory to show how such dynamics can arise naturally within well-designed systems, leading to stable but constrained outcomes.

We explore an alternative approach—delegated benchmarking—where high-level objectives remain clearly defined, but the design of mandate-specific benchmarks is entrusted to those closer to the information. This shift preserves the clarity and accountability that benchmarks provide, while better aligning incentives, reducing hidden risks, and supporting stronger talent retention. By repositioning benchmarks as tools for fair measurement rather than day-to-day steering, institutions can foster a more cooperative and adaptive equilibrium—one that strengthens oversight while enabling the pursuit of sustainable outperformance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨传统基准投资框架的局限性，提出委托基准作为替代方案，通过游戏理论和代理理论分析如何实现更好的激励对齐和长期价值创造。
AI.research_question: 如何设计投资基准框架来避免传统基准导致的谨慎行为限制，同时保持问责制和长期价值创造能力？
AI.motivation: 随着投资组合演变为复杂的多资产策略，传统基准框架可能无意中鼓励谨慎或狭隘的行为，限制了真正的长期价值创造潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 游戏理论和代理理论
AI.method: 理论分析和框架构建
AI.findings: 委托基准方法能够保持基准提供的清晰度和问责制，同时更好地对齐激励、减少隐藏风险并支持更强的人才保留。
AI.theory_contributions: 将基准重新定位为公平测量工具而非日常指导工具，可以促进更合作和适应性的均衡状态。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了一种新的基准设计方法，能够在加强监督的同时实现可持续的超额收益。

title: Chapter 1: Regime Change, Parties, and the Politics of Access

detail.title: Chapter 1: Regime Change, Parties, and the Politics of Access
detail.abstract: What are the politics of access in diverse and developing states? How does access to state institutions and to civil society affect policy and regime trajectories? This chapter lays the conceptual foundation for answering these questions by defining a regime as a bundle of reforms that structure access to political power, and regime change as the cumulative reconfiguration of those reforms. It distinguishes between democratization, typically studied retrospectively as a threshold model culminating in mass suffrage or competitive elections, and liberalization, a gradual, incremental, and often reversible process of reform that may expand or contract rights without the necessary endpoint of "democracy". The framework positions parliamentary parties as central gatekeepers but also liberators of access, shaping both “who gets to play” (through changing the rules of whose preferences are aggregated according to identities such as age, property, gender, nationality, or residency) and “the rules of the game” (how the preferences are aggregated). Focusing on the far earlier liberalizing electoral reforms to "who gets to play",  parliamentary parties include and exclude social groups for the regime. These early decisions of inclusion and exclusion, made under conditions of intense competition and incomplete information, determine whether liberalization stabilizes democracy, cycles between regime types, or sets the stage for autocratic consolidation. By recasting regime change as a long-term struggle over access, the chapter develops a framework for understanding how the politics of liberalization structured the divergent paths of democracy, autocracy, and fascism in Europe’s first wave of democratization.

title: Higher Education Inclusion for Refugees and International Protection Applicants in Ireland through the Universities of Sanctuary Movement-'Today I have the Keys, and I am Wearing my Good Coat'
affiliations: UCD Sutherland School of Law, Dublin City University, University of Limerick - Mary Immaculate College, Independent and South East Technological University

detail.title: Higher Education Inclusion for Refugees and International Protection Applicants in Ireland through the Universities of Sanctuary Movement-'Today I have the Keys, and I am Wearing my Good Coat'

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This chapter analyses the challenges and opportunities accessing higher education (HE) in Ireland for refugees and international protection applicants or forced migrants (The European Commission defines a forced migrant as; ‘A person subject to a migratory movement in which an element of coercion exists, including threats to life and livelihood, whether arising from natural or man-made causes (e.g. movements of refugees and internally displaced persons as well as people displaced by natural or environmental disasters, chemical or nuclear disasters, famine or development projects).’  With reference to the Universities of Sanctuary Ireland (UoSI) movement, established in 2016, the chapter is contextualised within access complexities to HE for forced migrants in Ireland, and exploration of education as both a right and a public good. In addition, stemming from a recent study, it offers insights into the HE experiences for Sanctuary scholarship recipients through their lived experiences. Higher education national policy and strategy, as it pertains to race and race equality (Higher Education Authority [HEA], 2022) is discussed, coupled with issues concerning legal status, and lack of appropriate housing and welfare rights for forced migrants, highlighting significant barriers in terms of access. The chapter discusses how the UoSI movement, concerned by legal, systemic, financial, cultural and structural barriers, challenges the status quo through its three core principles: learning what it means to seek sanctuary; taking positive action; and sharing best sanctuary-related practice, in so doing, providing a capability-enhanced environment for relevant stakeholders, including forced migrants, academic and professional service staff and students in higher education institutions (HEIs) in Ireland.

title: MinimalSTFGate: An Efficient Gating Architecture for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
affiliations: Jinan University

detail.title: MinimalSTFGate: An Efficient Gating Architecture for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
detail.abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have shown great promise for solving partial differential equations, but often suffer from computational inefficiency and difficulty in capturing complex spatio-temporal dependencies. This paper introduces MinimalSTFGate, a simplified spatio-temporal feature gating mechanism that addresses these limitations while maintaining high solution accuracy. Starting from a comprehensive Full STFGate architecture with separate spatial and temporal processing pathways, we identify and eliminate unnecessary computational complexity through principled simplification. Our approach reduces computational overhead by up to 40% compared to the Full STFGate baseline while achieving superior or comparable performance across six benchmark PDE problems including Burgers, heat, wave, Poisson, Allen-Cahn, and Navier-Stokes equations. The method is designed to handle both one-dimensional time-dependent problems and multi-dimensional spatial problems through a unified gating framework. Through comprehensive experiments and ablation studies, we demonstrate that MinimalSTFGate provides an effective balance between computational efficiency and solution quality. While the method incurs a modest computational overhead (approximately 11% compared to standard MLP), this cost is justified by significant accuracy improvements (6-12% error reduction) and enhanced solution quality, making it particularly valuable for high-precision engineering applications where solution accuracy is critical. The proposed method offers a practical solution for improving PINN efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MinimalSTFGate，一种简化的时空特征门控机制，用于提高物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的计算效率，同时保持高精度求解偏微分方程的能力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个简化的时空特征门控机制，在保持PINNs高精度的同时显著提高计算效率？
AI.motivation: PINNs在求解偏微分方程方面表现出巨大潜力，但存在计算效率低下和难以捕捉复杂时空依赖性的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）理论框架，结合时空特征门控机制，从完整的Full STFGate架构出发进行有原则的简化。
AI.method: 提出MinimalSTFGate方法，通过消除不必要的计算复杂性，在保持单独空间和时间处理路径的同时减少计算开销。
AI.findings: MinimalSTFGate相比Full STFGate基线减少高达40%的计算开销，在六个基准PDE问题上实现相当或更优的性能，包括Burgers、热传导、波动、Poisson、Allen-Cahn和Navier-Stokes方程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的门控框架，能够同时处理一维时间相关问题和多维空间问题，为PINNs的效率优化提供了新的理论思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法为高精度工程应用提供了实用解决方案，在仅增加约11%计算开销的情况下实现6-12%的误差减少，特别适用于对求解精度要求严格的应用场景。

title: Property Taxes and the Great Recession: The Role of Property Tax Limits
affiliations: Tax Policy Center and Independent

detail.title: Property Taxes and the Great Recession: The Role of Property Tax Limits

declarations.funderStatement: This research was partly funded by the Lincoln Institute of Land Policy.

detail.abstract: Using 2000-2016 county-level data from 39 states, we study how falling home prices affected property tax revenues under various property tax limits. Revenues adjusted gradually, reflecting lags in assessments and millage offsetting. With national shocks absorbed, responses to positive and negative base changes were broadly symmetric, though specifications without year effects suggest stronger offsetting in downturns. Assessment limits cut the passthrough from home prices to taxable values by nearly half, while combined assessment and rate limits pushing systems toward rate-driven taxation. States with levy limits had lower passthrough coefficients between assessed values and revenues.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2000-2016年美国39个县的县级数据，分析了房价下跌对不同财产税限制政策下财产税收入的影响。研究发现收入调整存在滞后性，评估限制将房价对税基的传导效应削减近半，而综合评估和税率限制使税收体系向税率驱动型转变。
AI.research_question: 房价下跌如何影响不同财产税限制政策下的财产税收入？
AI.motivation: 了解在房价波动情况下，不同类型的财产税限制政策如何影响地方政府财政收入，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财产税理论、税收限制政策效应理论、财政分权理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2016年美国39个州的县级面板数据进行实证分析，控制年度效应，研究房价变化对财产税收入的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1) 收入调整存在滞后性；2) 评估限制将房价对税基的传导效应削减近半；3) 综合评估和税率限制使税收体系向税率驱动型转变；4) 征收限制州的评估价值与收入之间的传导系数较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对财产税限制政策作用机制的理解，揭示了不同类型限制政策在房价波动环境下的差异化效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府在房价波动时期制定合理的财产税政策提供决策参考，有助于维持财政收入的稳定性。

title: Exploring The Opportunities and Challenges of Deep Generative Models for Building Energy Research Applications
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) - School of Engineering, University of British Columbia (UBC) - School of Engineering, Laurentian University and University of British Columbia (UBC) - School of Engineering

detail.title: Exploring The Opportunities and Challenges of Deep Generative Models for Building Energy Research Applications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors would like to gratefully acknowledge MITACS Canada and FortisBC for funding and supporting this research.

detail.abstract: Building energy data is critical for data-driven energy modeling and downstream energy research applications. Nevertheless, accessing high-quality real-world energy data remains challenging due to privacy and security concerns. Deep generative models (DGMs), as advanced deep learning techniques, have attracted increasing attention for their potential in synthesizing building energy data and augmenting original datasets. This article presented a systematic review of existing literature spanning from 2015 to 2025 that employs DGMs across multiple domains of building energy research. The review begins with an overview of major DGM architectures, including Generative Adversarial Networks, Variational Autoencoders, and Diffusion Models. Subsequently, we identified seven primary research thematic clusters where DGMs have been applied and recognized the advantages of DGMs in these applications. Based on these findings, we analyzed key challenges associated with their adoption in these applications, including: (1) limited availability of open-source datasets, (2) a lack of model benchmarking, (3) high computational demands, and (4) model interpretability and generalization ability issues. Finally, we proposed priority areas for future research works, such as expanding open-source building energy datasets, further exploring Diffusion Models for energy data synthesis, and addressing the computational burden associated with DGMs training. Additionally, the use of SHapley Additive exPlanations is recommended to enhance model transparency and interpretability. This review aims to provide building energy researchers and stakeholders with a critical overview of the potential opportunities and benefits of DGMs in relevant research applications, highlight current limitations, and offer guidance for addressing data scarcity concerns through the development of application-specific DGMs.

AI.tldr: 本文对2015-2025年间深度生成模型在建筑能源研究中的应用进行了系统性综述，分析了主要DGM架构、应用领域、优势挑战，并提出了未来研究方向。

title: Fiscal Populism and Democratic Setbacks: Challenges of Transparency and Tax Justice in a Globalized World
affiliations: University of Coimbra Institute for Legal Research

detail.title: Fiscal Populism and Democratic Setbacks: Challenges of Transparency and Tax Justice in a Globalized World
detail.abstract: Fiscal populism threatens democracy by coupling short-term tax giveaways and clientelistic spending with denial of budget constraints. Immediate relief is bought at the cost of future burdens, eroding trust, transparency and accountability. By simplifying complex debates and fueling "fiscal illusion," it distorts tax justice and entrenches regressive outcomes. In a globalized economy, capital mobility and tax competition amplify risks and hinder coordination. This article proposes fiscal education, active transparency (including disclosure of tax expenditures), legal limits that safeguard responsibility with flexibility, and international cooperation (OECD/EU rules, budgeting, fiscal responsibility laws). Effective taxation of multinationals and fortunes is pivotal for democratic resilience.

AI.tldr: 财政民粹主义通过短期减税和庇护性支出与预算约束否认相结合，威胁民主，造成未来负担、侵蚀信任和透明度，扭曲税收正义并固化累退结果。全球化经济下资本流动和税收竞争加剧风险。文章提出财政教育、主动透明度、灵活法律限制和国际合作等解决方案。
AI.research_question: 财政民粹主义如何威胁民主制度，以及如何通过政策工具应对这一威胁？
AI.motivation: 财政民粹主义在全球范围内兴起，通过短视的财政政策破坏民主制度的长期健康，需要系统性分析和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政民粹主义理论、民主韧性理论、财政透明度理论、税收正义理论
AI.method: 理论分析和政策建议

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体可行的应对策略，包括财政教育方案、透明度机制设计、法律限制框架和国际合作路径。

title: Towards a New "Saudi Model" of Sovereign Investment: The Role of Investment Income and Asset Recycling in Sustaining Saudi Arabia's Big Push Beyond 2030
affiliations: Center for Sustainable Development and Global Competitiveness, Stanford University, Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: Towards a New "Saudi Model" of Sovereign Investment: The Role of Investment Income and Asset Recycling in Sustaining Saudi Arabia's Big Push Beyond 2030
detail.abstract: This paper proposes several policies to sustain the investment push initiated by Vision 2030. Specifically, it draws attention to the role that investment income from domestic and foreign assets held by Saudi Arabian government-owned and -supported investors can play in providing sustainable funding for continued economic transformation beyond 2030. Investment income in local and foreign currency can grow and diversify Saudi Arabia’s revenue sources, providing income that is uncorrelated with oil and non-oil tax revenues. The paper adopts a broad understanding of investment income. For the provision of foreign income, we outline proposals to build a global investment portfolio than can serve as a permanent endowment, along the lines of several established global sovereign wealth fund (SWF) peers. With respect to domestic income, we identify the potential income distributions from maturing local investments and an “asset recycling” approach in which income, rent and sales proceeds are reinvested into new investments in the Saudi economy. Given the size of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), many of our proposals focus on what will be a natural evolution of its mandate: an increasing focus on income provision from its initial focus on domestic investments required under the first decade of Vision 2030. This evolution will align with historical experience of several SWFs. The evolution of its domestic portfolio will also establish a parallel with private-equity finance as the PIF matures from the world’s largest “start-up” fund during the initial phases of Vision 2030 to a more of mature model offering a source of patient permanent capital.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过沙特阿拉伯政府所有和支持的投资者持有的国内外资产投资收入，为2030年愿景后的经济转型提供可持续资金的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 如何通过投资收入为沙特阿拉伯2030年愿景后的经济转型提供可持续资金？
AI.motivation: 减少对石油收入的依赖，实现收入来源的多元化和可持续性，支持经济转型的长期发展。

AI.findings: 投资收入可以成为与石油和非石油税收收入不相关的收入来源，PIF应从初创基金向成熟模式演变。

title: Beliefs and Stock Market Fluctuations: New Evidence from the Past Seven Decades
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Beliefs and Stock Market Fluctuations: New Evidence from the Past Seven Decades
detail.abstract: We build a new dataset with subjective expectations of equity returns and earnings from an independent equity analysis firm spanning 1956 to 2024. Our new measure of expected returns is highly correlated with the earnings-price ratio, is contrarian in response to past stock returns, and predicts future stock returns. These findings contrast with subjective expectations of individual investors and professional forecasters, which are weakly, or even negatively, correlated with our new expected return series. Disagreement between sophisticated and individual investors is associated with higher trading volume. Our findings are consistent with a model of heterogeneous beliefs, where naive investors extrapolate past returns (rather than past dividends) while sophisticated investors are close to rational.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个新的主观预期股票回报和收益数据集，发现专业分析师的预期回报与盈利价格比高度相关，且能预测未来股票回报，这与个人投资者的预期形成鲜明对比。
AI.research_question: 专业分析师与个人投资者在股票回报预期上是否存在系统性差异？这些差异如何影响市场行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注个人投资者的主观预期，缺乏对专业分析师预期回报的全面分析，需要比较不同投资者群体的预期差异及其市场影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质信念模型，其中理性投资者基于基本面分析，而天真投资者基于过去回报进行外推预测。
AI.method: 构建1956-2024年独立股权分析公司的主观预期数据集，分析预期回报与盈利价格比的相关性，检验预期对过去回报的反应模式及其预测能力。
AI.findings: 专业分析师的预期回报与盈利价格比高度相关，对过去回报呈逆向反应，并能预测未来回报；个人投资者预期与专业预期弱相关甚至负相关；投资者分歧与交易量正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为异质信念理论提供实证支持，区分了理性投资者和天真投资者的不同预期形成机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资决策提供专业预期参考，帮助理解市场分歧对交易行为的影响。

title: Beyond Diversification: Managing Hidden Concentration Risks in Derivatives Portfolios
affiliations: Premia Research LLC

detail.title: Beyond Diversification: Managing Hidden Concentration Risks in Derivatives Portfolios
detail.abstract: This article briefly discusses various incidents of unexpected correlations across seemingly diverse commodity and financial markets, which can cause failures in risk management. Accordingly, the article also covers the necessary antidotes for managing such potentially hidden concentration risks in a derivatives portfolio, namely (a) understanding the fundamental drivers of each commodity strategy, (b) simulating a portfolio under various shocks to uncover macro exposures, and (c) identifying whether seemingly unrelated trades are held in common by traders and investors in highly leveraged portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了看似不同的商品和金融市场之间意外相关性导致风险管理失败的问题，并提出了管理衍生品组合中潜在隐藏集中风险的应对措施

detail.abstract: This research paper examines the September 2025 presidential proclamation that conditions entry of H‑1B nonimmigrants on a one‑time $100,000 fee. It is an educational attempt to understand the statutory foundations—INA §§ 212(f) and 215(a) (presidential entry‑restriction authority) and the H‑1B fee scheme under INA §§ 101(a)(15)(H)(i)(b) and 214—while mapping the constitutional backdrop provided by Kleindienst v. Mandel, Trump v. Hawaii, and Youngstown Sheet & Tube Co. v. Sawyer. Early agency guidance, notably the USCIS memorandum limiting the fee to new petitions filed after 21 September 2025, is analyzed to delineate the scope of the restriction. The paper contrasts U.S. entry‑control powers with analogous mechanisms in other common‑law jurisdictions and evaluates the proclamation’s legality under the INA, the APA, and constitutional due‑process and equal‑protection standards. Central to the analysis is whether the fee constitutes a permissible “restriction on entry” under § 212(f) or an ultra‑vires re‑pricing of a congressional fee regime, implicating Youngstown Category 3 scrutiny. Anticipated litigation theories, including ultra‑vires, APA, and constitutional challenges—are outlined, and practical compliance guidance for employers and workers is provided. The conclusion asserts that while the proclamation may survive deferential review as an entry restriction, its structural encroachment on congressional fee authority renders it vulnerable to successful legal challenge.

detail.title: The (Surprisingly Undramatic) Impact of Brexit on United Kingdom Copyright Law

contentType.other: Pre-publication (unedited and unformatted) draft of article to be published

publicationDetails.detailsText: It has been accepted to appear in [2025] Media and Arts Law Review xxx

detail.abstract: In the immediate wake of the Brexit vote, questions were raised concerning Brexit’s potential impact in the sphere of copyright law. Would it, for example, bring about a return to the form of copyright law that had existed in the UK before the EU harmonization programme began in the early 1990s?  Would the UK’s newly acquired legislative freedom result in significant divergence from the EU copyright acquis in the short, medium or long term? Would the “fair use” defence be adopted (or re-adopted)? At a few years’ distance from these turbulent events, we can now reflect on the way in which this decoupling has been achieved and offer an initial assessment of its impact. It is argued here that, despite the rhetoric marking the Brexit process, the UK legislature and courts have, initially at least, adopted a conservative approach to the independent development of the law. As a consequence, copyright rules in this jurisdiction have not yet diverged to any great extent from the EU acquis. It is suggested that this approach has arisen, in part at least, as a consequences of the general legal structures put in place under the European Union Withdrawal Act 2018 (as amended) to ensure legal certainty in the UK at a time of potential disruption. However, it also appears to be the product of judicial reluctance to disturb rules that have become integral to the operation of UK copyright law over the last few decades.

title: Who Gets to Play? Enfranchisement in Diverse Societies: Political Inclusion (and Exclusion) in Democratizing Hungary

detail.title: Who Gets to Play? Enfranchisement in Diverse Societies: Political Inclusion (and Exclusion) in Democratizing Hungary
detail.abstract: This article examines why, when, and how parties in nondemocratic states liberalize political rights. I advance a threat model of enfranchisement in which elites balance threats to incumbency and the national order to determine who is included and excluded in a liberalizing regime. Using evidence from the Kingdom of Hungary (1867-1918), I show that enfranchisement was less a response to democratic pressure, economic concerns over taxation and state capacity, or nationalist policy than a political strategy to manage threats, first from parliamentary opposition, then cumulated from extra-parliamentary parties. Rather than accommodating organized groups, elites selectively extended rights to unorganized groups, using observable traits such as size and cohesion to assess ex-ante threat. This analysis disentangles political logics from nationalist rhetoric and economic concerns, contributing to theories of electoral reform by identifying the strategic logic of selective inclusion in multiethnic electoral autocracies.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates why Delaware has become the dominant corporate law jurisdiction in the United States. We argue that Delaware's preeminence lies in its flexible, judge-made standards, which adapt to changing economic conditions and balance managerial discretion with investor protection. Delaware's market share surged from 1980 to 2010, a period marked by merger waves and rising institutional ownership. Using a structural model that incorporates this heterogeneity, we show that demand for legal flexibility, rather than doctrinal clarity, explains Delaware's dominance. Our analysis highlights the value of common-law adaptability and contributes to debates on legal origins and investor protection.

title: The Hispanic US Mutual Fund Managers
affiliations: Northumbria University and Northumbria University

detail.title: The Hispanic US Mutual Fund Managers
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether U.S. mutual fund investors are biased against Hispanic fund managers. Using a comprehensive panel of 12,693 funds domiciled in the U.S. between 1989 and 2024, we document a paradox: Hispanic managers consistently deliver marginally higher abnormal returns (Carhart four-factor alpha) and lower volatility compared with non-Hispanic peers, yet attract significantly lower net flows. Performance persistence tests, both parametric and non-parametric, confirm that Hispanic managers' superior performance is durable over monthly to annual horizons and across investment strategies. To explore the behavioural foundations of this paradox, we conducted a large-scale survey of U.S. investors and an Implicit Association Test (IAT). The survey revealed systematic under-allocation to Hispanic-surnamed managers and lower confidence ratings, while the IAT confirmed implicit bias, with Hispanic surnames more strongly associated with negative attributes. Taken together, the evidence demonstrates that Hispanic fund managers face structural disadvantages in attracting capital that are not explained by performance or risk, but by explicit and implicit investor biases. These findings contribute to the literature on mutual fund performance, behavioural finance, and diversity in asset management, and highlight the need for greater awareness of ethnicity-related barriers in capital allocation.

title: Uncorking the Twenty-First Amendment: A Spirited Exception to Distill the Dormant Commerce Clause

detail.title: Uncorking the Twenty-First Amendment: A Spirited Exception to Distill the Dormant Commerce Clause

publicationDetails.detailsText: American University Law Review, Volume 74, pp. 1819-1850.

detail.abstract:
Few goods have played as potent a role in shaping constitutional doctrine as alcohol. By repealing national Prohibition and granting states sweeping authority to regulate intoxicating liquors within their borders, the Twenty-first Amendment carved out a singular exception in American constitutional law—one that has long stood in tension with the Dormant Commerce Clause (“DCC”), which prohibits states from discriminating against interstate commerce.

This Note surveys the constitutional landscape created by the Twenty-first Amendment, beginning with a historical overview of DCC jurisprudence, the Prohibition era, and the legislative history of the Twenty-first Amendment. The analysis then focuses on the uneasy constitutional cocktail between Section 2 of the Twenty-first Amendment, which grants the states significant regulatory authority over alcohol, and the principles of the DCC, which broadly prevent states from enacting legislation that discriminates against interstate commerce. This tension most recently culminated in Tennessee Wine & Spirits Retailers Ass’n v. Thomas, where the uneasy balance between plenary state powers over alcohol and enforcing DCC principles gave way to a manifest exorcism of the former and an incipient threat to the latter.

To protect the nondiscrimination principle at large, this Note argues that Section 2 constitutionalized an exception to the DCC to preserve the intended regulatory autonomy over alcohol granted to states and now provides a novel argument to ensure the consistency of longstanding DCC doctrine: there cannot be a constitutional exception to a nonexistent doctrine, and Section 2 serves as retroactive proof that the DCC deserves to remain on tap, offering the Court a well-earned tonic to prevent the nondiscrimination principle from drying out.

detail.abstract: This study examines the impacts of ADUs on market rate rents in Norman eleven months after the introduction of the policy. AI.method: 采用双重差分法来检验ADU政策对租金的影响假设。
AI.findings: Norman市的ADU政策对当地租金价格没有可测量的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了ADU政策效果评估的研究范围，从房产价值扩展到租金影响分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Norman市政府提供了政策效果评估，建议需要采取措施提高ADU的采用率以实现政策目标。

title: Fellas, Let's Buy Greenland
affiliations: University of Southern Queensland - Faculty of Business and University of Southern Queensland - Faculty of Business, Education, Law and Arts

detail.title: Fellas, Let's Buy Greenland
detail.abstract: To say that President Trump takes a businessman’s approach to international affairs is obviously too simplistic. But it is also not completely wrong. In finance, the businessman’s game is most clearly set down in that subfield of the discipline known as corporate finance. Here we find all the techniques that are needed to decide whether an idea is a good one and whether it should be pursued and, ultimately, how to win at business. But corporate finance is more than a collection of techniques. The techniques serve a decision-making philosophy, a structured approach for choosing what to do. If this philosophy is used in international affairs, taken to its logical extremes by a caricature of the quintessential businessman, how would a matter as seemingly delicate as Greenland be handled? Well, you would view the United States as a corporation, you would think of US citizens as shareholders, you would pursue maximum shareholder value, to that end you would compute the net present value of buying Greenland, and if the net present value is positive you would make your takeover bid. It would be just like the old days. One might even be tempted to call in Carl Icahn as a consultant, since T. Boone Pickens is no longer available.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将企业财务决策哲学应用于国际事务的可行性，以特朗普总统考虑购买格陵兰岛为例，分析了将国家视为公司、公民视为股东的商业化决策模式。
AI.research_question: 如果将企业财务的决策哲学应用于国际事务，特别是以购买格陵兰岛为例，会产生怎样的决策过程和结果？
AI.motivation: 特朗普总统的商业背景引发了对商业决策模式在国际事务中应用的思考，企业财务提供了系统化的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业财务理论，特别是净现值(NPV)分析、股东价值最大化原则，以及将国家类比为公司的理论框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析，通过将国际事务决策与企业财务决策进行类比，构建理论模型。
AI.findings: 按照企业财务逻辑，购买格陵兰岛的决策将基于净现值计算，如果净现值为正就会进行收购，体现了纯粹商业化的决策思维。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将企业财务决策框架应用于国际政治经济分析的新视角，拓展了商业决策理论的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解商业背景领导人的决策模式提供了分析工具，有助于预测和解释类似格陵兰岛收购提议的决策逻辑。

detail.abstract: The paper presents the Contract Aggregation Framework (CAF) for the modeling and analysis of data streams representing arbitrary financial contracts, ranging from privately negotiated deals to exchange-traded securities. We discuss the need for a flexible and extensible data model and provide an exemplar representing trading in corporate equities and bonds. Using a measure of Market volume, we review several analytical methods to explore the data. Initial observations support the benefits of the framework to integrate and analyze disparate sources of data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了合约聚合框架（CAF），用于建模和分析代表任意金融合约的数据流，涵盖从私人协商交易到交易所交易证券。通过市场交易量指标，探讨了多种分析方法，初步观察支持该框架在整合和分析不同数据源方面的优势。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个灵活可扩展的数据模型来整合和分析代表各种金融合约的数据流？
AI.motivation: 金融市场中存在大量不同类型和来源的金融合约数据，需要一个统一的框架来整合这些分散的数据源进行分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合约聚合框架（CAF）作为核心理论框架，提供金融合约数据建模和分析的方法论基础。
AI.method: 采用市场交易量作为衡量指标，运用多种分析方法对框架进行验证，并以公司股票和债券交易为例进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 初步观察结果表明，该框架能够有效整合和分析不同来源的金融数据，支持对复杂金融合约的深入分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个通用的金融合约数据建模框架，为金融数据分析提供了新的理论工具和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和投资者提供了整合和分析多样化金融合约数据的实用工具，有助于提升市场分析和决策能力。

title: Buy Now, Pay Later: The Cost of Instant Gratification
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Buy Now, Pay Later: The Cost of Instant Gratification
detail.abstract: This paper examines the rise of Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services and their impact on young consumers in the United States. BNPL platforms like Klarna, Affirm, and Afterpay allow users to make purchases immediately and pay in installments, often without interest. While these services offer convenience and instant gratification, they also carry risks such as debt accumulation, late fees, and limited consumer protections. The paper compares BNPL with traditional credit cards and Equated Monthly Installments (EMIs), highlighting differences in accessibility, interest rates, credit-building potential, and consumer safeguards. Through case studies, including Coachella ticket and electronics purchases, the paper demonstrates how BNPL influences spending behavior and financial decision-making. Ultimately, the study emphasizes the importance of financial literacy and responsible use to prevent the pitfalls associated with BNPL, while acknowledging its benefits as an alternative payment method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究BNPL服务在美国年轻消费者中的兴起及其影响，分析BNPL与传统信用卡和EMI的差异，通过案例研究展示BNPL对消费行为的影响，强调金融素养的重要性。
AI.research_question: BNPL服务如何影响美国年轻消费者的消费行为和财务决策？
AI.motivation: BNPL服务的快速增长及其对年轻消费者的潜在风险和益处需要系统研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、金融决策理论、支付系统比较理论
AI.method: 案例研究法（包括Coachella门票和电子产品购买案例）
AI.findings: BNPL提供便利但存在债务积累风险，与传统支付方式在可及性、利率等方面存在显著差异
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对新兴支付方式影响消费者行为的理解，完善金融科技服务评估框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为消费者提供BNPL使用指导，为监管机构提供政策建议，促进负责任使用

title: Export Slowdown and Importers' Sourcing Market Concentration
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Export Slowdown and Importers' Sourcing Market Concentration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Using the China Customs Database from 2010 to 2016, we find that the export slowdown leads importers to concentrate their import sourcing market. This effect is more pronounced at eastern coastal cities, less-developed cities, and private firms, while state-owned firms and foreign-investment firms are almost unaffected. The mechanism shows that export slowdown deters the local business environment, such as reducing employment and wages, discouraging migrants, lowering individuals' mental health, and motivating the local government to cut expenditure on public services. All these economic outcomes raise the opportunity cost for importers to diversify their sourcing market. Our findings highlight supply chain vulnerabilities from export shocks and suggest policy measures to support export resilience.

AI.tldr: 出口放缓导致进口商集中采购市场，这一效应在东部沿海城市、欠发达城市和民营企业中更明显，而国有企业和外资企业几乎不受影响。机制分析表明出口放缓通过恶化当地商业环境（如减少就业和工资、抑制移民、降低心理健康水平、削减公共服务支出）提高了进口商多元化采购的机会成本。
AI.research_question: 出口放缓如何影响进口商的采购市场集中度？
AI.motivation: 研究出口冲击对供应链脆弱性的影响，为支持出口韧性的政策提供依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 出口冲击对当地商业环境的影响机制，机会成本理论
AI.method: 使用2010-2016年中国海关数据库进行实证分析
AI.findings: 出口放缓导致进口商集中采购市场，效应在东部沿海城市、欠发达城市和民营企业中更显著
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了出口冲击通过商业环境渠道影响供应链决策的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供支持出口韧性和缓解供应链脆弱性的具体建议

title: Threshold Dynamics Across Domains: From Naruto Whirlpools to Crime Criticality under the JX Theory
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Threshold Dynamics Across Domains: From Naruto Whirlpools to Crime Criticality under the JX Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a cross-disciplinary threshold model linking natural and social phenomena. We examine the Naruto Strait whirlpools as a fluid-dynamical threshold event and compare them with crime criticality as a social threshold event. In both domains, invisible flows accumulate until a critical level is reached; crossing that level produces a sudden, visible manifestation. We model vortex strength as a function of velocity 𝑣, head difference Δℎ, and topographic factor 𝑘, with visibility once 𝑊 ≥ 𝑊 𝑐. In parallel, JX theory defines the cost of silence as 𝐽(𝑥) = 𝛼𝐸(𝑥) + 𝛽𝑆(𝑥) + 𝛾(1-𝐴(𝑥)) , with manifestation once 𝐽(𝑥) ≥ 𝐽 𝑐. A logistic form captures the non-linear onset of events. The structural analogy outlines a universal threshold model bridging natural and social sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个跨学科阈值模型，将自然现象与社会现象联系起来。通过比较鸣门海峡漩涡（流体动力学阈值事件）与犯罪临界性（社会阈值事件），建立了统一的阈值模型框架。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的阈值模型来连接自然现象和社会现象中的临界事件？
AI.motivation: 自然和社会系统中都存在临界阈值现象，但缺乏统一的跨学科理论框架来描述这些现象的共性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值理论、临界现象理论、流体动力学理论、JX理论（沉默成本理论）
AI.method: 比较分析方法，建立数学模型：漩涡强度模型（W = f(v, Δh, k)）和沉默成本模型（J(x) = αE(x) + βS(x) + γ(1-A(x))），采用逻辑函数形式描述非线性事件发生。
AI.findings: 自然和社会系统中的临界事件具有相似的结构特征：不可见流的积累达到临界水平后产生突然的可见表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个连接自然科学和社会科学的通用阈值模型，揭示了不同领域临界现象的共性结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨学科研究提供了新的理论工具，有助于理解复杂系统中的临界转变现象。

title: Multi-Source FX Analytics and Predictive Modeling: A Practical Pipeline for Spot Forex Pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF)

detail.title: Multi-Source FX Analytics and Predictive Modeling: A Practical Pipeline for Spot Forex Pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF)
detail.abstract: This paper presents an end‑to‑end workflow for acquiring, cleaning, analyzing, modeling, and backtesting foreign exchange (FX) spot data across four major currency pairs using dual data vendors (Alpha Vantage, Yahoo). The study implements arbitrage discrepancy checks, risk/return profiling, mean‑variance portfolio optimization, deep learning (LSTM) forecasting, regime detection via Hidden Markov Models (HMM), dynamic position sizing, and systematic strategy backtesting. Results illustrate methodology integration rather than production performance claims. Limitations (data latency, look-ahead risks, simplistic execution logic) are acknowledged, and improvement paths are outlined.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个完整的外汇现货数据处理流程，包括数据获取、清洗、分析、建模和回测。研究采用双数据供应商，实现了套利检查、风险收益分析、算法优化、LSTM预测、HMM制度检测等多种技术。结果主要展示方法论集成，而非实际交易效果。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个完整的外汇数据处理和交易策略开发流程，并展示各种数据分析和机器学习技术在外汇市场中的集成应用？
AI.motivation: 建立一个结构化的工作流程来处理外汇数据的全过程，从数据获取到策略回测，并展示各种先进技术的实践集成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 套利理论、现代投资组合理论（均值-方差优化）、深度学习（LSTM）、隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）、系统交易策略开发。
AI.method: 使用两个数据供应商（Alpha Vantage、Yahoo）获取4个主要货币对的外汇现货数据，实现数据清洗、套利差异检查、风险收益分析、均值-方差投资组合优化、LSTM预测模型、HMM制度检测、动态位置调整和系统回测。
AI.findings: 研究主要展示了各种方法论的集成可行性，而非实际交易效果。识别了数据延迟、预知风险、简单执行逻辑等局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个完整的外汇数据分析和交易策略开发的理论框架，展示了多种先进技术在金融市场中的集成应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了一个可复制的工作流程案例，包括数据清洗、风险管理、机器学习预测、制度检测等实用技术，并指出了改进方向。

title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Inflation in Ghana: An Empirical Analysis
affiliations: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning, Christian Service University College and Transilvania University of Brasov

detail.title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Inflation in Ghana: An Empirical Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The authors declare that no Generative AI was used in the creation of this manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Formulating effective policy in developing economies requires a deep understanding of the complex interplay between macroeconomic variables and price levels. Against a backdrop of persistent inflation and macroeconomic turbulence, this study creates a detailed empirical model to explain price-level movements in Ghana using key determinants like money supply, fiscal balance, public debt, and exchange rate. Using quarterly time-series data from 1990 to 2023, the study employs Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL), Vector Error Correction (VECM), and Vector Autoregressive (VAR) models. This approach allows for a robust analysis of both the shortand long-run relationships between macroeconomic indicators and inflation. The models confirm that the exchange rate and money supply are primary drivers of price levels in both the short and long term. The ARDL model identified a significant long-run relationship, with an error correction term (-0.47) suggesting that 47% of deviations from long-term equilibrium are corrected quarterly. The VECM confirmed this long-run stability, while Variance Decomposition analysis showed that the exchange rate and money supply account for over 60% of changes in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over a 10-period horizon. The findings highlight the critical need for Ghanaian policymakers to manage currency fluctuations and money growth to ensure price stability. While interest rate policy remains a key short-term tool, sustainable inflation control hinges on prudent exchange rate management and policies that support real GDP growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过ARDL、VECM和VAR模型分析加纳1990-2023年季度数据，发现汇率和货币供应量是价格水平的主要驱动因素，47%的长期均衡偏差每季度得到修正，汇率和货币供应量解释CPI变化的60%以上。
AI.research_question: 加纳宏观经济变量与价格水平之间的复杂互动关系是什么？汇率和货币供应量如何影响价格水平？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家制定有效政策需要深入理解宏观经济变量与价格水平的复杂互动关系，特别是在持续通胀和宏观经济动荡的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论，特别是货币数量论和汇率传递理论，分析货币供应、财政平衡、公共债务和汇率对价格水平的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1990-2023年季度时间序列数据，采用自回归分布滞后模型（ARDL）、向量误差修正模型（VECM）和向量自回归模型（VAR）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 汇率和货币供应量是短期和长期价格水平的主要驱动因素；ARDL模型显示47%的长期均衡偏差每季度得到修正；VECM证实长期稳定性；方差分解显示汇率和货币供应量解释CPI变化的60%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在发展中国家背景下宏观经济变量对价格水平的影响机制，特别是汇率传递和货币供应传导渠道的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳政策制定者提供了管理汇率波动和货币增长以确保持续价格稳定的具体政策建议，强调汇率管理和支持实际GDP增长政策的重要性。

title: Climate Transition Risks and Bank Liquidity Creation: Adapting to Regulatory Shocks
affiliations: Universidad de Oviedo, NTNU Business School, The Norwegian University of Science and Technology, University of Zurich - Department Finance and University of Newcastle - Newcastle University Business School

detail.title: Climate Transition Risks and Bank Liquidity Creation: Adapting to Regulatory Shocks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 25-75
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how climate transition risks affect bank liquidity creation using the 2004 U.S. NOx Budget Trading Program (NBP)—a cap and-trade regulation affecting 11 states—as a quasi-natural experiment. Banks in NBP-affected states curtailed liquidity creation, primarily through balance sheet adjustments: reduced lending and risky asset holdings, and increased off-balance sheet exposures. Beyond this mechanism, banks adopted strategic responses to earnings pressure, including slower net interest income growth, greater noninterest income, and expanded derivative use. The effect is stronger for large, riskprone, profitable, and diversified banks, as well those in competitive markets and Democratic-leaning states. Governance matters: banks with higher common ownership are more resilient, while both shortand long-term investor horizons are associated with reduced liquidity creation—especially under shortterm ownership. Results are robust to matching, placebo tests, spillover adjustments, and event-study designs. Overall, climate regulation reshapes bank intermediation through portfolio rebalancing and strategic adaptation, with critical implications for financial stability and climate policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候转型风险对银行流动性创造的影响，以2004年美国NOx预算交易计划作为准自然实验。研究发现受影响的州银行通过调整资产负债表（减少贷款和风险资产、增加表外业务）来减少流动性创造，并采取战略应对措施（减缓净利息收入增长、增加非利息收入、扩大衍生品使用）。影响在大型、高风险、盈利能力强、多元化银行以及竞争市场和民主党倾向州更显著。治理结构也很重要，共同所有权高的银行更具韧性。
AI.research_question: 气候转型风险如何影响银行的流动性创造？
AI.motivation: 理解气候政策对银行中介功能的影响，特别是流动性创造这一核心功能，对于评估气候转型风险对金融稳定的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行流动性创造理论、气候转型风险理论、银行风险管理理论和公司治理理论。
AI.method: 采用准自然实验方法，以2004年美国NOx预算交易计划为外生冲击，使用匹配方法、安慰剂检验、溢出效应调整和事件研究设计进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 受气候政策影响的州银行显著减少了流动性创造，主要通过资产负债表调整和战略收入管理。影响在特定类型银行和市场环境中更为显著，治理结构对银行韧性有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析气候政策对银行流动性创造的影响机制，揭示了银行应对气候风险的策略行为，丰富了气候金融和银行中介理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定气候政策提供实证依据，帮助银行管理气候转型风险，对维护金融稳定和优化气候政策实施具有重要参考价值。

title: Soft Information, Hard Decisions: AI Advising
affiliations: Texas A&M University and University of Oxford, Saïd Business School

detail.title: Soft Information, Hard Decisions: AI Advising
detail.abstract: We model AI-based advising via large language models (LLMs) by introducing preference uncertainty-capturing soft information-alongside standard fundamental uncertainty, and we validate model predictions through LLM-driven simulations. While human advisors can elicit soft information, their misaligned incentives lead to information loss (Crawford and Sobel, 1982). In contrast, LLMs are unbiased, but digitizing soft information is challenging: it is difficult to formalize and LLMs' limited memory prevents synthesis across extended conversations. We model this communication as the investor's optimal stopping problem with Brownian information flow and solve it in closed form. Simulations using multi-round LLM advising confirm our theoretical frictions and are benchmarked against standard portfolio questionnaires. Results show that deeper conversations mainly help investors clarify and learn their own objectives, improving decisions; however, impatience or early stopping reduces recommendation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入偏好不确定性（软信息）来建模基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的投资建议，并通过LLM驱动的模拟验证模型预测。研究发现，深度对话主要帮助投资者澄清和学习自身目标，从而改善决策，但缺乏耐心或过早停止会降低建议质量。
AI.research_question: LLMs作为投资顾问如何有效传递软信息（偏好不确定性）？与人类顾问相比有何优势与局限？
AI.motivation: 人类顾问因激励错配导致信息损失，而LLMs虽无偏见但难以数字化软信息且受限于记忆能力。需要探索LLMs在投资建议中的沟通效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Crawford和Sobel（1982）的沟通模型，引入布朗信息流的最优停止问题，建立LLM建议的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用封闭形式求解最优停止问题，并通过多轮LLM建议模拟验证理论摩擦，与标准投资组合问卷进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 深度对话主要帮助投资者澄清自身目标，改善决策；缺乏耐心或过早停止会降低建议质量；LLMs在传递软信息方面存在记忆限制的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了沟通理论，将软信息与基本面不确定性结合，为LLM建议提供了新的理论模型和封闭解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司优化LLM建议系统提供实践指导，强调深度对话的重要性，并警示过早停止的风险。

title: Representative Politics in Africa: The Vacuum of Ideology
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: Representative Politics in Africa: The Vacuum of Ideology
detail.abstract: Africa's representative politics is vibrant but ideologically limited. Unlike Europe, where ideologies matured from a triangular balance of state, science, and market, Africa inherited the state through colonial rule, while scientific institutions were constrained and markets shaped for extraction. Today, the market is firmly present in the political courtyard, often guiding state decisions through investors, creditors, and external actors. What remains weaker is the mediating role of knowledge institutions that could translate complexity into durable ideological programmes. Universities, parliaments, and planning bodies are present but fragile, and mobilisation frequently substitutes for ideology in electoral life. Country experiences vary: Uganda's debates were overshadowed by dependence, Ghana has developed programmatic competition, Kenya's parties continually reconstruct, and Zimbabwe combines liberation ideology with strong scientific traditions. Complexity science suggests African politics will evolve along unpredictable paths, but one principle stands clear: state, science, and market must interact in balance.

AI.tldr: 非洲政治充满活力但意识形态受限，由于殖民历史导致国家、科学和市场三要素不平衡发展，市场影响力强大而知识机构薄弱，各国情况各异但需要三要素平衡互动
AI.research_question: 非洲代表性政治为何充满活力但意识形态受限？如何实现国家、科学和市场的平衡互动？
AI.motivation: 理解非洲政治发展的独特路径，分析殖民遗产对意识形态形成的影响，探索非洲政治未来发展的可能方向
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家-科学-市场三角平衡理论，复杂性科学，殖民遗产理论
AI.method: 比较案例分析（乌干达、加纳、肯尼亚、津巴布韦），历史制度分析
AI.findings: 非洲政治因殖民历史导致三要素发展不平衡，市场影响力强大而知识机构薄弱，各国发展路径各异但都需要三要素平衡
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于非洲政治发展的国家-科学-市场三角平衡框架，拓展了复杂性科学在政治分析中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家政策制定提供平衡发展的理论指导，强调了知识机构在政治发展中的关键作用

title: An Overview of Disaster Governance in Thailand with a Focus on Flooding: Chiang Mai Case Study
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An Overview of Disaster Governance in Thailand with a Focus on Flooding: Chiang Mai Case Study

declarations.funderStatement: The authors would like to acknowledge all UR Field Lab organizers and participants for providing the opportunity and space to conduct this study and write this policy brief.

detail.abstract: This brief aims to provide an overview of disaster governance in Thailand with a focus on flooding. This study made use of information and data from related literature and government documents such as the Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Act of 2007 and the National DRM Plan of 2015. These were used to provide a snapshot of how the government manages risks. Along with this, Key Informant Interviews IKII) were done with the Head of the Strategy and Management Unit and a Policy and Plan Analyst from the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM). A Municipal Sanitary Engineer from Chiang Mai Municipality was also interviewed. Case studies of two communities within the Nong Hoi and Ban Klang sub-districts in Chiang Mai were also done in order to provide insights on how Disaster Risk Management (DRM) in Thailand actually plays out. The case study involved a Focused Group Discussion (FGD) and interviews with the community members. Representatives from a Non-Government Organization (NGO) for elderly people, the Foundation for Older Persons' Development (FOPDEV) were also interviewed to supplement the findings.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文献分析、政府文件审查、关键人物访谈和社区案例研究，分析了泰国洪水灾害治理的现状与实施情况
AI.research_question: 泰国洪水灾害治理体系如何运作？灾害风险管理在实际社区层面如何实施？
AI.motivation: 了解泰国灾害治理体系，特别是洪水灾害管理的实际运作情况，为改进灾害风险管理提供参考
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害治理理论、灾害风险管理框架
AI.method: 混合研究方法：文献分析（2007年灾害预防与减灾法案、2015年国家灾害风险管理计划）、关键人物访谈（DDPM官员、市政工程师）、案例研究（Nong Hoi和Ban Klang社区）、焦点小组讨论、NGO访谈
AI.findings: 提供了泰国灾害治理体系的概览，揭示了政策制定与社区实施之间的差距，展示了不同利益相关者在灾害管理中的角色
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家灾害治理的实证研究，提供了泰国特定背景下的灾害管理理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为泰国政府改进灾害管理政策提供实践建议，为社区层面的灾害风险管理提供可操作指导
